title: Director of Learning, Development & Culture
description:
Director of Learning, Development & Culture

By Landmark Hospitality

About By Landmark

By Landmark Hospitality is a vertically integrated hospitality organization operating a portfolio of 15+ restaurants, event venues, and boutique hotels across New Jersey and Pennsylvania. With over two decades of experience in adaptive reuse development and hospitality operations, the company has established itself as a leader in delivering exceptional guest and team experiences at distinctive properties, including Liberty House, The Ryland Inn, Felina restaurants, Logan Inn, and The Albion Summit.

At Landmark, employees are called Memorymakers — a reflection of our commitment to creating meaningful and memorable experiences for guests and team members alike. Our culture is grounded in sincerity, service excellence, and community engagement.

Position Overview

We are hiring a senior learning leader to design, build, and scale the training and development infrastructure that supports a multi-property hospitality portfolio. This is a builder's role for someone who has personally architected curricula, learning pathways, and leadership development programs across multi-unit operations — and who is energized by doing it again from the ground up at By Landmark.

The Director of Learning, Development & Culture is the strategic owner of how Memorymakers grow, advance, and connect to our standards. The role partners closely with Area Partners, property leadership, and ownership to translate operational priorities into programs that move performance, retention, and culture.

What this role is not: This is not a generalist HR role. It does not own recruiting, talent acquisition, employee relations casework, benefits administration, or payroll. Those functions sit elsewhere in the organization. Candidates whose experience is weighted toward HR generalist work or talent acquisition — rather than training architecture and learning program design — are not a fit for this seat.

Location & Work Model

Field-facing role based in New Jersey or Pennsylvania, with regular travel across By Landmark properties in both states. Candidates should expect meaningful on-site time at our venues.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Architecture

  • Design and build standardized onboarding pathways for hourly, management, and salaried roles across all properties — from blank page to launch
  • Architect and continuously improve role-specific training pathways with clear onboarding, certification, and advancement milestones
  • Select, implement, and own the company's LMS and supporting learning technology; drive content development, adoption, and measurement
  • Build and operate a train-the-trainer model that delivers consistent execution across 15+ properties
  • Develop and facilitate leadership development and management training programs that support internal promotion and succession planning
  • Curate and produce training content covering service standards, operational excellence, leadership, and people management
  • Maintain the company training calendar across in-house programming and outside specialty vendors
  • Define and report on the metrics that matter — completion rates, retention, internal promotion rates, time-to-proficiency, and performance outcomes
  • Facilitate mentorship relationships between senior leadership and emerging talent

Culture & Organizational Development

  • Partner with senior leadership on performance management frameworks, employee engagement, and retention strategy
  • Work with Area Partners and property leadership to assess team health, morale, and culture alignment across all locations; design interventions to close identified gaps
  • Lead recognition programs, feedback mechanisms, and engagement surveys; translate findings into actions leadership can use
  • Serve as a visible culture champion across properties — modeling By Landmark's values and reinforcing the Memorymaker identity through daily presence and organization-wide programming
  • Ensure training programs and content reflect applicable federal, state, and local labor regulations

Qualifications

This role is built for a training architect — not an HR generalist. The strongest candidates have:

  • 7+ years in Learning & Development, Training, or Talent Development leadership — preferably in multi-unit hospitality, restaurants, events, or comparable service-driven environments
  • Demonstrated experience designing training infrastructure from scratch — not just managing existing programs. We want to see programs you architected and launched, not inherited
  • Hands-on LMS ownership — selection, implementation, content build-out, adoption tracking, and ongoing optimization
  • Curriculum design and facilitation credibility — you can both build the program and deliver it in front of a room
  • Multi-site operating fluency — you understand how to drive consistency across geographically distributed teams with different operating rhythms
  • Strong project management discipline — comfortable owning the calendar, the platform, the content, and the metrics in parallel
  • Excellent communication skills across all levels — from line-level Memorymakers to ownership

Preferred Experience

  • Multi-unit hospitality, restaurant, or event-venue organization
  • Building leadership development programs for emerging and senior managers in service environments
  • Familiarity with NJ and PA labor markets and employment regulations
  • Supporting organizational growth, change management, or operational scaling

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary, commensurate with experience
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Dining privileges across Landmark properties
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Lost Time Claims Specialist, Workers’ Compensation primarily manages indemnity claims. The Lost Time Claims Specialist is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and determination of compensability for work-related injury and disease claims following established guidelines to determine benefit eligibility. The Lost Time Claims Specialist also serves as a resource to Medical Only Claims Specialists and Claims Specialist Trainees. The position’s objective is to provide superior service in a cost-effective manner to achieve best possible outcomes as well as proactively collaborate across the enterprise to ensure alignment of objectives and foster continuous improvement.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Evaluates and establishes an action plan to manage medical and indemnity benefits associated with injury and occupational disease claims to their most cost- effective conclusion.
2. Decides the outcome of the claim using sound judgment by applying established policy, procedures, regulations and guidelines.
3. Gathers facts by conducting interviews with all involved parties and considers all the elements of the claim prior to issuing a decision.
4. Take recorded statements when necessary.
5. Determines eligibility of indemnity and medical benefits once salary information and medical treatment plans have been secured and processed within the designated authority levels.
6. Utilize proactive reserving behaviors to ensure adequate case reserves which reflect the probable ultimate outcome based on the current known circumstances throughout the life of the claim.
7. Actively identifies and develops the investigation of and pursuit of subrogation recoveries when possible.
8. Consults with assigned claim director, return to work specialists, nurse case managers, internal/external medical, and legal on current and/or recommended treatment, litigation or rehabilitation plans to ensure claims outcomes are achievable and appropriate.
9. Works collaboratively with the injured worker, employer, outside counsel, and health and rehabilitation professionals to manage the claims costs and promote quality medical care.
10. Works collaboratively with the injured worker, employer, assigned return to work specialist, and medical providers to facilitate the injured worker’s safe and timely return to work.
11. Manages claims litigation, including expenses, by collaborating and providing direction to panel counsel throughout the life of the claim.
12. Analyzes reports from external resources such as physicians, attorneys, and/or vocational rehabilitation experts to evaluate and adjust claim strategies as needed.
13. Evaluates and negotiates claim settlements utilizing human relation skills and technical knowledge to achieve the best possible outcome.
14. Presents and summarizes claim details at internal team staffing, participates in discussions, and provides guidance as needed.
15. Consults with assigned claim director if the loss becomes significantly complex or presents significantly increasing financial exposure.
16. Follows established claims best practices related to medical management, litigation, fraud/abuse and recovery.
17. Effectively and independently uses available resources to prioritize, organize, and complete work in a timely manner to meet jurisdictional requirements, timeframes, and internal metrics.
18. Develops presentations for special projects such as internal/external meetings and conferences as needed.
19. Along with the claim director, regional vice president and other claims staff, participates in claim reviews, onboardings, etc. for our policyholders and agents.
20. Proactively collaborate with our policyholders to ensure alignment of objectives and foster continuous improvement.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:
1. Nonessential function: other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.
• Three years of experience in the field of workers’ compensation insurance required.
• Ability to manage claims through the litigation process.
• Internal candidates must demonstrate knowledge of Encova Best Practices guidelines and meet quality standards.
• One valid workers’ compensation adjuster license is strongly preferred. Must be eligible to obtain additional licenses as required.
• Must pass the claims adjuster license exam(s) as assigned within 90 days of being hired.
• Preference may be shown to candidates with multiple state claims management experience.
• Experience in workers’ compensation claims practices and laws, court procedures, precedents and state statutes.
• Ability to use logic and sound reasoning to identify alternative solutions for problem-solving.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Ability to multitasks and manage time effectively and productively.
• Work effectively independently as well as in a team environment.
• Develop and maintain strong, effective internal and external relationships.
• Work effectively in a paperless environment.
• Skilled in the use of laptops, claims management systems, and other typical business-related programs such as Microsoft Office suite.

Encova Insurance makes every effort to reasonably accommodate disabilities to permit performance of the essential functions and candidates who need such accommodation are encouraged to seek it. title: Medewerker Operationeel Datamanagement
description:
Ben jij die resultaatgerichte Medewerker Operationeel Datamanagement die samen met ons Nederland verder wil verduurzamen? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Team Operationeel Datamanagement (ODM) beheert en verwerkt een breed scala aan data. Denk aan gegevens die nodig zijn voor een correcte energiefactuur én voor het optimaliseren van onze warmtenetten voor meer dan 90.000 warmte- en koudeklanten. ODM beheert alle meters en meetdata van Ennatuurlijk. Met behulp van diverse analysetools controleren we de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van onze data en zorgen we er samen met externe partners voor dat afwijkingen en storingen snel worden opgelost.

Dit is (nog) geen kwestie van een druk op de knop en vraagt om iemand die verbeterkansen herkent en actief bijdraagt aan verdere optimalisatie. Je analyseert datastromen, onderzoekt uitval en afwijkingen en draagt actief bij aan het continu verbeteren van processen en datakwaliteit. Daarmee leg je de basis voor datagedreven energiemanagement. Dankzij jouw werk beschikken collega's over betrouwbare inzichten om onze productie-assets slimmer te onderhouden, beter te beheren en efficiënter in te zetten.

Wat ga je doen:

• Je beheert de datastromen binnen onze industriële automatiseringsomgeving (dit noemen wij OT-data) met behulp van AVEVA PI. Je bewaakt de volledigheid, juistheid en beschikbaarheid van procesdata vanuit installaties door data-alarmen te monitoren, data te valideren en afwijkingen tijdig te signaleren en terug te koppelen;

• Je zorgt voor een consistente en betrouwbare datastructuur door metadata en naamconventies toe te passen en wijzigingen door te voeren in afstemming met OT-specialisten;

• Je rapporteert periodiek over de datakwaliteit aan stakeholders en draagt actief bij aan het oplossen van geconstateerde datakwaliteitsproblemen;

• Je inventariseert de databehoeften van gebruikers, stemt prioriteiten af en beheert de backlog van datavraagstukken;

• Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt dashboards waarmee gebruikers inzicht krijgen in operationele prestaties en processen;

• Je werkt nauw samen met de externe applicatiebeheerder, platformbeheerder en je ODM-collega’s om de inzet van OT-data en de dataprocessen continu te verbeteren en zo bij te dragen aan een meer datagedreven organisatie.

Je gedijt goed in een organisatie waar je de ruimte krijgt om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en je talenten te benutten. We verwelkomen je graag in een team van 27 collega’s, inclusief 4 (werk)studenten, waarbij je zult samenwerken met de 3 collega’s in jouw subteam.

Wat we vragen

Een professional met een HBO werk- en denkniveau met een opleidingsachtergrond in de richting van Industriële Automatisering, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Data & Analytics, Informatica of vergelijkbaar die ons 32-40 uren per week wil komen versterken. Je bent klantgericht en analytisch sterk. Verder ben je:

· Een echte teamspeler met minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

· Ervaren in het ontwikkelen van dashboards en het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar heldere en bruikbare inzichten;

· Geïnteresseerd in de energiemarkt, procestechniek en/of industriële automatisering;

· Communicatief sterk, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, in de Nederlandse taal;

· Leergierig en gemotiveerd om ontwikkelingen binnen data en automatisering actief te volgen.

Wat we bieden

Met duurzame relaties kun je samen bouwen aan een duurzame toekomst. Wij geven je daarom graag wat je verdient.

· Fijne secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een NS Business Card, iPhone en laptop;

· Ruimte om hybride te werken inclusief een volledig ergonomische thuiswerkplek;

· De functie valt in schaal 4 van ons functiehuis, met een salarisbereik van € 3.528 tot € 5.125 bruto per maand;

· Je ontvangt 8% vakantiegeld (onderdeel van het Benefit Budget);

· Je ontvangt een bonus van maximaal 10% van het jaarsalaris;

· Je hebt recht op 31,5 vakantiedagen per jaar inclusief vitaliteitsverlof en 10 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen (onderdeel van het Benefit Budget);

· Je kunt het Benefit Budget flexibel inzetten op basis van jouw voorkeuren. Bijvoorbeeld extra verlofrechten kopen of maandelijks een deel van het opgebouwde budget laten uitkeren.

· Voordelen wanneer je een zorgverzekering hebt afgesloten bij Zilveren Kruis Achmea;

· Uitstekende pensioenopbouw bij ABP, inclusief aanvullende voorzieningen bij overlijden en arbeidsongeschiktheid. Een geruststellende gedachte voor de toekomst;

· Blijf fit! Gratis sporten bij EindhovenGym in ons pand of fiscaal vriendelijke verrekening van de kosten van een andere gym.

Daarnaast geven we je alle vertrouwen én de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt toegang tot een ontwikkelbudget dat je kunt inzetten voor opleidingen en trainingen die passen bij jouw groeiambities. Een prachtige kans in een organisatie die volop in beweging is waar jij met ons mee bouwen en groeien!

title: Per Diem Virtual Pediatric Speech-Language Pathologist
description:
About Us:

Ladder Health, an innovative virtual care platform built alongside clinicians at Boston Children's Hospital, serves as an end-to-end developmental partner for children (0-6 years old) with developmental delays. Ladder offers an alternative to waitlisted state-based programs or private pay practices, guiding families through our developmental screener, clinical evaluations, and comprehensive virtual care with specialized therapists (PT, OT, SLP). Our platform supports a coordinated care plan with resources, HIPAA-compliant messaging, and integration with pediatric care teams. title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
Tangible Markets builds secondary-transaction infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are banks, fund administrators, and secondaries teams whose workflows are technical, regulated, and specific. You sit between them and our product engineering.

The role blends solutions engineering with customer success, plus real engineering work. You lead technical discussions with clients, shape how the platform fits their workflow, own their success after go-live, and help build configurations and integrations that close the gap. You are not embedded on client sites full-time, and this is not a pure relationship role either. Most weeks split between client-facing work and hands-on technical work.

Full-time · Remote (European time zones preferred)

Tasks

Client-facing (roughly half the role)

  • Run technical discussions during onboarding: architecture reviews, security questionnaires, SSO and data-flow conversations with client IT teams
  • Translate client workflow requirements into product terms, and product capabilities into client terms
  • Own accounts after go-live: adoption, expansion, the quarterly “how is this actually going” conversation
  • Be the trusted technical contact when something breaks or a new requirement lands

Product and engineering (the other half)

  • Help build client-specific configuration, integrations, and glue code (SSO, data mappings, API integrations, etc.)
  • Turn recurring client asks into structured product requirements and argue for them with the product team
  • Prototype solutions fast, validate them with the client, then hand the generalizable parts to the engineering team
  • Write the runbooks and docs that make each client’s setup maintainable by someone other than you

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a technical role with client exposure: solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, or product engineering with heavy customer contact.
  • You can read and write production code: You don’t need to be the strongest or only engineer on the team, but “I’ll build it” has to be a real option, not a handoff.
  • You can hold a room: an SSO deep-dive with a bank’s IT security team in the morning, a product feedback session in the afternoon.
  • Financial services background, or evidence you absorb regulated domains fast.
  • You write clearly: Requirement docs, runbooks, and follow-up emails carry most of this job’s leverage.
  • Judgment about what to build, what to configure, and what to push back on.

Nice to have:

  • Anything fintech, especially on the vendor for banks (or other fintechs) side.
  • Prior work at an early-stage B2B company where you wore several hats.
  • Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance processes (vendor due diligence, DORA, GDPR).

What this role is not:

  • Not pre-sales quota-carrying. You join conversations for technical depth, not to close.
  • Not full-time on-site embedding. Client contact is regular but structured: calls, workshops.
  • Not a support queue. You own outcomes for accounts, not tickets.

Why this role matters:

Enterprise clients in private markets churn because nobody on the vendor side understood their workflow well enough to make the platform fit. This role exists so that someone does, and so that what they learn changes the product.

Process:

  1. 30-minute intro call
  2. Technical conversation around a real (anonymized) client scenario
  3. Working session: scope a solution and present it back
  4. Conversation with the founders

title: Correspondent - Marketplace

Job Summary:

The Residential Security Team Agent is tasked with numerous functions by providing support to a protective security detail in Jupiter, FL. This detail operates in a dynamic, multi-faceted, and fast-paced environment.

This position requires a strong medical background (higher than TCCC level—preferably EMT or medic experience), as well as the ability to swim and operate safely in both indoor and outdoor environments. Candidates with an intelligence background are strongly preferred.

This position requires the successful completion of a physical fitness test within the first 90 days of employment.

The ideal candidate will have a good personality and strong character, demonstrating coachability, professionalism, and a positive attitude. While prior Residential Security Team (RST) experience is beneficial, it is not required—we welcome motivated individuals coming straight out of the military who can learn quickly and adapt to a structured but team-oriented environment.

This is a 24/7 detail, requiring availability for days, nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed.

Duties:

Duties for this detail include, but are not limited to:

  • Ensure the overall safety and security of designated principals and their properties.
  • Maintain a knowledge of baseline principal, property, and neighborhood activities.
  • Monitor property and area activities and conditions via closed-circuit television camera system and physical perimeter checks.
  • Monitor traditional and social media for potential threats.
  • Controlling access to properties and maintenance of security logs for guests, service personnel, and vendors.
  • Drive or tail principal/s, family member, guests.
  • Conduct advance work as needed.
  • Screen and track mail and deliveries.
  • Monitor the following:
  • Weather and natural disasters
  • Traffic
  • Public safety incidents and trends
  • Neighborhood watch programs
  • Local and national current events
  • Coordinate with site staff to accomplish common tasks.
  • Complete daily household tasks and maintenance as requested by principals.
  • Ensures 24/7 operational readiness through stocking supplies and equipment upkeep.
  • Operate within parameters established by standard operating procedures and applicable laws.
  • Coordinate with and support executive protection element of the team.
  • Opportunities for driving and special off-site assignments/details.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in use and proper maintenance for all equipment (i.e., vehicles, medical supplies, communications devices, etc.).
  • Potential local travel approximately 5% -10% of the time to other RST sites or principal destinations.
  • Must be flexible and open to working overtime shifts whether they are night or day shift, coming in early and staying late if needed.
  • Must possess the ability to multitask in a very fast-paced environment.
  • Must be able to stay vigilant sitting in a vehicle or security office for extended periods of time.
  • Must be a proactive problem solver with the capability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Must possess a good understanding of the latest technology in security camera systems, use of smartphones, communications, and collaboration apps (Google Drive, Word, Excel & Power Point).
  • Must keep a professional appearance, have good personal hygiene.
  • Must be responsive via phone call, text and email as needed to support the team.
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to be personable, successfully interact with clients, superiors, peers, vendors and neighbors.
  • Submitting expense receipts.
  • Clocking in/out for work shifts.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Ability to successfully complete a physical fitness test within the first 90 days of employment.
  • Must possess a good understanding of the latest technology in security camera systems, use of smartphones, communications, and collaboration apps.
  • Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to converse with clients, superiors, peers, and vendors professionally and successfully.
  • EMT, combat medic, or advanced medical certification strongly preferred.
  • Ability to swim required.
  • Specific training related to this detail will be provided upon hire.
  • Exceptional emotional intelligence.
  • Strong situational awareness and attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks frequently and for long durations.
  • Excellent critical thinking and sound judgement.
  • Friendly, approachable and professional demeanor.
  • High moral and ethical character.

Position Certificates and Licenses:

  • Current Florida Guard Card (Class D license).
  • Current Florida Class G license.
  • A Valid United States Driver’s License.
  • CPR/First Aid/AED certified for Adults, Children, and Infants.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to patrol the property and access areas quickly.
  • Physically able to capture and detain individuals if necessary.
  • Prolonged periods sitting of 5+ hours at a desk and monitoring surveillance equipment.
  • Prolonged periods of standing on your feet without a break 4-5+ hours.
  • Must be able to lift 50 pounds at a time.
  • Must be able to lift, drag a human up to 200lbs or more, if necessary.
  • Must be able to bend, twist, stoop, crawl.
  • Being able to respond to physical attacks, natural disasters, evacuations.
  • Must be capable of operating in aquatic or coastal environments as needed.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Associates or bachelor’s degree.
  • Certification from a recognized EP school (this can be supplemented with 2+ years of relevant industry experience).
  • Graduation from a certified driving school is also preferable, but this too can be supplemented based on experience.
  • Military or law enforcement experience strongly preferred; recent veterans encouraged to apply.
  • Intelligence or protective intelligence background is a plus.
  • Proficient in the use of social media collection tools in support of protective intelligence.
  • Prior RST experience a plus, though not required.
  • Training in defensive tactics, counter surveillance/surveillance detection, and covert protection experience.
  • Active First Responder, Paramedic or EMT certifications a plus.
  • Regularly active in outdoor activities such as mountain biking, hiking, ocean sports, etc.

Detail Structure:

  • 12-hour shifts

title: Backend Engineer – Voyager Team (Bridge) Hungary, Budapest, Remote
description:
Budapest, Hungary / Engineering / Full-Time

People Matter Most!

We are a global team of Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Program Managers across Hungary, the US, and many other countries. We help our customers create work cultures that people love.

About the Product

Bridge is a software that people use for learning, self-development, and growing their careers. Our goal? Help organizations build a culture where people thrive.

Curious about what it looks like? Here is a quick intro:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IdelswTXQh8

The Reality of the Role: Voyager - Where Challenge Meets Ownership

At Bridge, our success is built on a massive, mission-critical Ruby on Rails monolith. While our strategic future is being built in Kotlin and Spring Boot, the 'engine' of our platform remains in Ruby. As a member of the Voyager Team, you will help us maintain and evolve this core ecosystem. You won’t just be patching bugs; you will learn to navigate architectural complexity, fix critical issues, and ensure that new features – whether written in Kotlin, Ruby, or TypeScript – integrate seamlessly.

The Ideals & DNA of a Voyager Engineer

  • Problem-Solver Mindset: You don't freeze when facing a complex codebase or a tricky issue. You know how to roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and methodically figure things out.
  • Analytical Thinking: Navigating in a large monolith requires the ability to see how things connect. You can look at legacy logic and understand its purpose.
  • Polyglot & Diverse Background: You have a broad history with tech stacks. You aren't emotionally attached to a single language; you’ve worked with multiple technologies, understand their trade-offs, and treat them simply as tools to solve business problems.
  • Direct Communicator: Our team has a strong, opinionated engineering culture. We value honesty, constructive friction, and direct feedback. You aren't easily offended by sharp critique; instead, you look for the objective truth in every technical debate.

Our Tech Stack:

  • Java or Kotlin SpringBoot-based REST API development ~40% of your time
  • Complex Ruby on Rails Web Application ~60% of your time
  • PostgreSQL database knowledge
  • Cloud Services:
    • AWS Aurora RDS Clusters
    • Apache Pulsar Messaging
    • Debezium Server-based ETL Data Pipeline
    • AWS Neptune Graph Databases
    • AWS OpenSearch
  • DevOps:
    • CI/CD - GitHub Actions, Spinnaker
    • Monitoring - DataDog
    • Terraform
  • Frontend: React & TypeScript (Strong advantage if you already know it or want to dive deeper into it).
  • Tooling: SAFe, JIRA, Confluence, Slack, GSuite
  • Laptop: MacBook Pro

What You Get

  • An async, trust-based culture: Work remotely, or come to our Allee office whenever you like.
    • True Autonomy, No Micro-management: We don’t track your hours or care when or where you log in; we focus entirely on your impact and results.
    • Design Your Own Workday: You have complete freedom to structure your day however it suits your life, whether you need to run errands, pick up your kids, or focus during non-traditional hours. Since we are a global team, some of our syncs and meetings happen in the US timezone (typically late afternoon/early evening CET), so we look for someone comfortable with this overlap.
    • Trust & Availability: The only rules are simple: show up for your scheduled meetings, keep the team updated if you step away, and be there to support your teammates when they need a hand.
    • High Transparency, Low Friction: We operate on mutual trust—just drop a quick heads-up to the team when you're taking off, and you're good to go.
  • The 'Voyager Perks' – Why It’s Worth It:
    • Modern Dev Tooling: We embrace modern engineering efficiency—GitHub Copilot (and other AI assistance tools) are fully provided to help you navigate, map out, and accelerate your work.
    • Real Influence: We are frequently consulted on company-wide technical decisions because we understand the system better than anyone else.
    • Elite Mentorship: Our team is home to several Guild Leads and long-time contributors. If you want to learn how a large-scale SaaS platform actually works under the hood, there is no better place.
  • Financial stability:
    • We offer you a competitive salary package (1.7 - 2.1M HUF gross/month depending on your seniority),
    • Bonus (based on the performance of the company),
    • Benefits: a comprehensive healthcare package provided by Medicover, SZÉP card, and other fringe benefits.

title: Superintendent - GC Division
description:
Louis Ptak Construction has a perfect opportunity for you.

Louis Ptak Construction has been building exceptional projects throughout California since 1998, serving as both a General Contractor and a carpentry subcontractor. Our portfolio includes some of California’s most high-end and bespoke residences. Our commitment to excellence and collaborative work environment makes us a sought-after employer in the construction sector.

We are looking for an experienced Site Superintendent to join our General Contracting team and help lead high-end custom residential projects with typical remodeling budgets of $10 to $25 million. These projects require deep technical construction knowledge, strong field leadership, and the ability to coordinate complex site conditions, detailed architectural plans, high-end finishes, and large subcontractor teams.

This is a great opportunity for a builder at heart. You may have started in the field as a carpenter or trade professional, and now you bring the experience, judgment, and leadership needed to turn a client's vision into an exceptional finished home. On our larger projects, you may work as part of a two-Superintendent site leadership team, partnering closely with another Superintendent, the Project Manager, Assistant Project Manager, Project Administrator, and trade partners to keep the project moving safely and efficiently to the highest standard of quality.

What you get to own:

  • Coordinate and direct day-to-day site activities for large, complex custom residential projects.
  • Lead site logistics, sequencing, safety, quality control, and subcontractor coordination on projects with multiple scopes happening at the same time.
  • Using architectural plans, lay out the entire house from axis lines/gridlines by directing concrete, structural steel, and carpenters on where to place the structure.
  • Review and markup shop drawings for structural and finish trades.
  • Build, maintain, and communicate the project schedule, including the critical path, look-ahead schedules, manpower needs, deliveries, and site constraints.
  • Support client, architect, designer, engineer, inspector, and subcontractor communication in the field.
  • Collaborate with PM, APM, PA, and subcontractors to foresee and solve problems.

What we’re looking for:

  • 20+ years of construction experience in high-end custom residential construction.
  • 10+ years of experience as a carpenter or other trade experience.
  • 5+ years' experience as a Superintendent
  • Experience building large custom residential projects, ideally with project budgets in the $10 million to $25 million range.
  • Currently has or has had a GC license and has run your own GC company, and wants to go back to working for someone else.
  • Strong ability to read architectural, structural, civil, and MEP plans and translate them into field execution.
  • Current experience using MS Project, Primavera, Procore, or similar construction management software tools is required.
  • Keen understanding of best practices for construction and building codes.

Benefits:

  • 401(k) with 4% match
  • Dental, vision, and health insurance
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee assistance program
  • Referral program

Join us at Louis Ptak Construction and be part of a team dedicated to building exceptional projects and fostering a collaborative work environment

title: Guest Service Associate-F&B
description:

Serve food courses and alcoholic beverages to guests. Set tables according to type of event and service standards. Answer questions on menu selections. Communicate with the kitchen regarding menu questions, the length of wait, re-cook orders, and product availability. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. title: Event Stylist
description:
Event Stylist By Landmark Hospitality

The planner's planner.

Every client and couple walks in with a big vision and a few butterflies. You're the one who handles both. Our Event Stylists are the calm at the center of life's happiest, busiest moments: part designer, part host, all planner.You make the complicated feel simple, the stressful feel handled, and every wedding and celebration feel like a one-of-one. Because it is.

If love the phrase, "so, tell me everything," this might be your favorite job.

Who we are - By Landmark is a leader in hospitality, owning and operating some of the region's most iconic venues such as Liberty House, Hudson House, Stone House, the Ryland Inn, Farmhouse, and Felina in New Jersey, and Hotel Du Village, the Logan Inn, and Cascade Lodge in Pennsylvania. Upscale restaurants, unforgettable event spaces, and boutique hotels, all built around one idea: creating memories our guests keep for a lifetime.

Our approach to hiring is simple. We look for thoughtful, caring, forward-thinking people who inspire and collaborate. Experience is always valued, but character is the true mark of a memorymaker.

What you'll do - Be the person a couple trusts with the biggest day of their lives, from the first hello to the last dance and the rock our corporate and social clients rely on.

  • Meet with couples and clients, listen closely, and gather every detail that makes their day theirs.
  • Show off our spaces so beautifully that guests can already picture themselves in them.
  • Design and produce the event start to finish (the vision, the timeline, the thousand little touches)
  • Keep clients in the loop and at ease, anticipating needs before they're spoken.
  • Research, quote, and close with both confidence and care.
  • Partner with our vendors and lead the event team so the day runs like clockwork.

  • 5+ years of event sales experience in upscale, fine-dining event spaces is preferred
  • A real passion for hospitality and the art of the event.
  • Comfortable with event software (Tripleseat is a big plus) and MS Office.
  • Warm, polished, and personable, a presence that puts people instantly at ease.
  • Sharp time management, excellent communication, and a gift for building relationships.
  • The ability to manage multiple events at once, independently, and keep every detail on track.
  • A strong work ethic, a client-first approach, and grace under pressure.
  • Flexibility for days, nights, weekends, and holidays — Wednesday through Sunday availability is a must (it's where the magic happens).
  • Experience with brides and corporate clients

What we offer

  • 401(k) matching
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Employee dining discount
  • Career advancement and real room to grow
  • Team engagement activities
  • A team that truly roots for you

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Sr. Product Owner - Care Coordination Services (CCS)

Summary of Position:

The Sr. Product Owner, Care Coordination Services (CCS) is the day-to-day owner of the product backlog for Verisma's Care Coordination product line. Reporting into Product Management, the Sr. Product Owner translates product strategy and customer requirements — including the build-out of net-new products such as our Forms solution and Referral Management platform — into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized sprint work that engineering can execute against. This is an execution-focused, team-facing role. The Sr. Product Owner partners closely with engineering, QA, design, and product management to keep the build cycle moving: refining the backlog, clarifying requirements, accepting delivered work, and removing ambiguity. While the Product Manager owns the product vision, roadmap, market positioning, and pricing, the Sr. Product Owner owns how that vision gets built — sprint by sprint — and is accountable for the quality and predictability of what the scrum team delivers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Owning, refining, and prioritizing the CCS product backlog in support of the roadmap
  • Writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and accepting completed work
  • Acting as the primary point of contact for engineering on requirements questions during the sprint
  • Partnering with Product Management on discovery, customer feedback, and release readiness for new CCS products
  • Duties & Responsibilities
  • Own and groom the CCS product backlog: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, attach supporting context, and keep the backlog ranked against the roadmap priorities set by Product Management
  • Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standup, sprint review, and retrospective ceremonies as the product representative on the scrum team
  • Translate roadmap initiatives — including the Forms solution, Referral Management platform, and other CCS programs — into release plans, epics, features, and stories that engineering can size and commit to
  • Make day-to-day prioritization and trade-off decisions inside the sprint; escalate scope or roadmap-level decisions to the Product Manager
  • Accept completed user stories against acceptance criteria and confirm release readiness
  • Partner with engineering and QA to triage defects, clarify edge cases, and resolve ambiguity quickly so the team is never blocked on requirements
  • Coordinate with UX/design to ensure flows and mockups are in place ahead of development
  • Support Product Management on customer discovery, user interviews, and validation sessions — bringing back insights that refine the backlog

  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, throughput, defect rates, scope changes); surface risks early
  • Contribute to competitive and market awareness by reviewing customer feedback, support tickets, and field input, and routing relevant signals to Product Management
  • Act as a connective tissue across product, engineering, QA, design, customer success, and implementation for the CCS product line
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and purpose-built product/AI tooling) to accelerate product operations — drafting and refining user stories, synthesizing customer feedback, generating release notes and documentation, analyzing support and usage data, and speeding up backlog grooming
  • Perform other appropriate duties, as assigned, to meet the needs of the department and the company
  • Live by and promote Verisma Core Values

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail

  • Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed, for customer visits, discovery, and team collaboration

Job Title: Groundperson

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Job Summary:

The Groundperson assists in supporting all activities that occur on the ground during vegetation maintenance and management along power lines. This role identifies safety hazards while utilizing various types of tools and equipment to address brush and clean-up debris.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws or other applicable tools to cut brush, limbs and logs of larger trees.

  • Gathers manageable size brush, limbs and logs and carries to the designated chipping area.

  • Applies herbicide and growth regulators to brush and stumps.

  • Operates and works around hazardous equipment, such as chainsaw, pole pruner, stump grinder, woodchipper, etc.

  • Adheres to and helps educate less experienced employees on company policies, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods and OSHA regulations.

  • Utilizes a variety of tools (i.e. rake, shovel, leaf blower) to remove debris from work area.

  • Feeds brush and debris into woodchipper.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Staging and clean-up of tools and equipment at the job site. Maintains a neat and orderly work area.

  • Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Ability to adhere to company and industry safety requirements.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to comprehend and/or read and write both written and verbal job instructions and safety information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge on how to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred, but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Spanish - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Other Language _________________ - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

☐Yes-Occasional (up to 5%)

☐Yes-Moderate (5% to 25%)

☐Yes-Substantial (25% to 50%)

☒Yes-Extensive (greater than 50%)

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Possesses the ability to lift, move, and maneuver up to 50 pounds on an infrequent basis and up to 30 pounds on a frequent basis.

  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.

  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

Environmental Factors:

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to indoor and outdoor working conditions.

  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.

  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.

  • Routine exposure to noise, vibration, working hazards such as proximity to moving parts, mechanical equipment, moving vehicles, gasoline powered equipment, electrical current, heights, exposure to heat, exposure to chemicals, work in close quarters, narrow aisles or passageways, communicable diseases, bloodborne pathogens, cleaning chemicals, dust, odors, and a variety of pests.

Cargo: Groundperson

Resumen del puesto:

El Groundperson asiste en todas las actividades que se realizan en el suelo durante el mantenimiento y la gestión de la vegetación a lo largo de las líneas eléctricas. La persona en esta función identifica los peligros de seguridad mientras utiliza diversos tipos de herramientas y equipos para lidiar con la maleza y limpiar residuos.

Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para el triturado.

  • Trabaja en el suelo con sierras manuales, sierras de uso en el suelo u otras herramientas aplicables para cortar arbustos, ramas y troncos de árboles grandes.

  • Recoge ramas, maleza y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular y los transporta al área designada para astillar.

  • Aplica herbicidas y reguladores de crecimiento a la maleza (brush) y los troncos.

  • Opera y trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos, como motosierras, podadora de extensión, trituradoras de troncos, trituradoras de madera, entre otros.

  • Cumple y ayuda a capacitar a empleados con menos experiencia sobre las políticas de la empresa, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de la Administración de Salud Ocupacional (OSHA).

  • Utiliza diversas herramientas (por ejemplo, rastrillo, pala, soplador de hojas) para retirar los residuos del área de trabajo.

  • Alimenta la trituradora de madera con maleza y residuos.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Se encarga de la preparación y limpieza de herramientas y equipos en el lugar de trabajo. Mantiene un área de trabajo limpia y ordenada.

  • Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson. sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de pertenencia de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Capacidad para cumplir los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.

  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.

  • Capacidad para comprender o leer y escribir tanto las instrucciones laborales como la información de seguridad, en forma escrita y verbal.

  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.

  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.

  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.

  • Conocimiento sobre cómo realiza rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).

  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.

  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Se prefiere título de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.

  • Debe contar con credenciales vigentes de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR), o poder obtenerlas en un plazo de 90 días tras la contratación.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Departamento de Transporte (Department of Transportation, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de la FMCSA.

  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.

  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.

Requisitos de idioma (leer, escribir, hablar):

Inglés: ☒ leer, ☒ escribir, ☒ hablar

Español: ☐ leer, ☐ escribir, ☐ hablar

Características físicas:

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

  • Flexionarse, estirarse, permanecer de pie, caminar, trepar, levantar, cargar, sujetar, hablar, oír y realizar movimientos repetitivos de manera efectiva. Ocasionalmente alcanzar hacia arriba o hacia abajo.

  • Ejercer hasta 100 libras (45 kg) de fuerza ocasionalmente o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza con frecuencia, o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza de manera constante para mover objetos.

  • Poseer la capacidad para levantar, mover y maniobrar hasta 50 libras (23 kg) ocasionalmente y hasta 30 libras (14 kg) con frecuencia.

  • Debe tener agudeza visual suficiente para determinar la precisión, pulcritud y exhaustividad del trabajo asignado o para hacer observaciones generales del entorno; agudeza visual cercana, como para leer una pantalla de computadora, materiales impresos, inspeccionar defectos pequeños o utilizar instrumentos de medición.

  • Poder entrar y salir de vehículos y equipos varias veces al día.

Factores ambientales:

Las personas en este puesto pueden estar expuestas a los siguientes factores:

  • Exposición habitual a condiciones de trabajo tanto interiores como exteriores.

  • Exposición habitual a las condiciones meteorológicas, climáticas y de temperatura, como lluvia, calor, sol, frío y nieve.

  • Exposición habitual a la naturaleza, como plantas irritantes, insectos que pican o muerden, polvo, etc.; el puesto se desarrolla al aire libre en terrenos irregulares.

  • Exposición habitual a ruido, vibraciones, peligros laborales como la proximidad a piezas móviles, equipos mecánicos, vehículos en movimiento, equipos con motor de gasolina, corriente eléctrica, alturas, calor, productos químicos, espacios reducidos, pasillos o conductos estrechos, enfermedades transmisibles, patógenos de transmisión sanguínea, productos de limpieza, polvo, olores y diversos tipos de plagas.

Nos comprometemos a garantizar el cumplimiento de esta política en los procesos de reclutamiento, contratación, asignación, promoción, traslado, formación, compensación, beneficios, actividades laborales, acceso a instalaciones y programas, y en el trato general durante el empleo.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Contractual)
description:
Job Description

Unifocus is an integrated workforce management software platform offering intelligent automation for daily work orders management, housekeeping activities, facility maintenance, survey solutions, scheduling & labour management, and time & attendance built for the hospitality market and other dynamic scheduling environment.

We support hotels, restaurants, casinos, and more with our innovative web-based and mobile software suite. Some of the chains we work with include Hilton, Rosewood, Shangri La, Accor, IHG, Hoxton, Corinthia, Oetker Collection etc. We are a small but growing team, and you'll have opportunities to express yourself and make meaningful contributions to our products and the company.

Visit https://www.unifocus.com for more details.

About:

Join our team as a Data Engineer (ETL and Data Modelling) and contribute to our mission of leveraging data to drive meaningful insights and deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

What will you do?

  • Design, develop and own robust data pipelines, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement Data Lake, Dare Warehouse and Lakehouse solutions with different
    architecture patterns
  • Ensure data quality, integrity and governance across all stages of data lifecycle
  • Monitor and optimize performance of data engineering pipelines.
  • Contribute to design principles, best practices, and documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deeply understand business requirements,
    translating them into effective technical design, implementations that support the organization's
    data-driven initiatives.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior members of the data engineering team, promoting knowledge transfer, a culture of continuous learning and skills development.

We are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
  • A seasoned Data Engineer with 8+ years of experience.
  • Deep experience in designing and building robust, scalable data pipelines – both batch and real-time
  • using modern data engineering tools and frameworks.
  • Proficiency in AWS Data Services (S3, Glue, Athena, EMR, Kinesis etc.).
  • Strong grip on SQL queries, various file formats like Apache Parquet, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or
    Hudi and CDC patterns.
  • Experience in stream processing frameworks like Apache Flink or Kafka Streams or any other
    distributed data processing frameworks like pySpark.
  • Expertise in workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced
    environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of database systems (both relational and NoSQL) and experience with data
    warehousing concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with data integration tools and a strong familiarity with cloud-based data

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, facilitating effective collaboration with both

title: Flex Agent - Executive Protection Agent
description:
Job Details:

Job Title: Flex Agent- Executive Protection Agent

Job Type: Job Type – On Call/As Needed -Please note: Flex agent positions have the potential to develop into a full time offer with the company. This is not a guarantee, but a possibility.

Compensation: $700/day

FLSA: Non-exempt

Job Summary:
This is an armed or unarmed Flex Agent position supporting Executive Protection assignments. Domestic travel is required, with occasional international travel. Candidates must be comfortable in fast-paced environments, in social settings with high-profile public figures, and able to jump into action to support teams with little to no training.

Prior Executive Protection experience on an embedded team supporting a single client is required for this role. While prior military or law enforcement experience is relevant and preferred, it does not replace the need for private sector EP experience.

Flex Agents support short-term needs on embedded teams and remain on a roster for deployment as needed. Our Global Operations team coordinates with agents to confirm availability and interest in open shifts. Candidates with additional experience and certifications will have greater opportunities to accept assignments.

Job Description:
The Flex Agent is tasked with numerous functions providing overall support to protective security details in the United States. This detail operates in a dynamic, multi-faceted, and fast paced environment. Below are just some of the functions and responsibilities:

  • Ensure the overall safety and security of designated Principals
  • Required to drive Principals to various personal/business venues and/or additional off-site assignments
  • Demonstrate proficiency in use and proper maintenance for all equipment used in support of the protective operations program (i.e. vehicles, medical supplies, communications devices, etc.)
  • Must maintain an acceptable professional appearance
  • Must be able to communicate with the Principal’s, staff, coworkers, and other third party vendors utilizing a customer service approach
  • Capable of adapting to various tasks that would be assigned outside of traditional security operations/roles
  • Ability to interact with children
  • Capable of on-the-spot critical thinking and improvisation
  • STRONG emotional intelligence and self-awareness
  • Must be comfortable in a variety of social settings, with ability to socially engineer desired outcomes
  • Must be willing to submit to pre-employment, post-accident and random drug testing as determined by management
  • Working shifts that can include days/nights/weekends/holidays/OT
  • Travel when required, both domestic and international
  • Provide close protection to Principals at various venues, events, business meetings, personal trips, etc.
  • Agents must maintain a positive attitude through a wide variety of situations, as well as, must conduct themselves in a manner which contribute to a positive and professional work environment
  • Conduct advance work for routes, venues, and travel trips
  • Agents must have proficient writing skills to complete detailed reports
  • Coordinate with Principal’s staff and outside personnel, to facilitate seamless operations for our Principals
  • Maintain physical fitness to stand on your feet for several hours without a break, provide protective coverage during physically taxing activities including running, swimming, hiking, as well as maintain long schedules in the field.
  • Capable of responsibly engaging to an active threat against the Principal
  • Agent must be proficient in defensive tactics, in order to deescalate, or actively engage in potential threats against the Principals

Position Certificates and Licenses:

  • Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC)
  • A Valid United States Driver’s License
  • Current Passport with more than six months expiration
  • CPR/First Aid/AED certified for Adults, Children, and Infants

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Certification from a recognized EP school
  • Active PERC
  • Graduation from a certified driving school is also preferrable
  • Military or Law enforcement experience is a plus
  • Training in defensive tactics, counter surveillance/surveillance detection, and covert protection experience
  • Active First Responder, Paramedic or EMT certifications a plus
  • Regularly active in outdoor activities such as mountain biking, hiking, ocean sports, etc.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of relevant EP experience
  • Must possess a good understanding of the latest technology in use of smartphones, communications/tracking apps, and collaboration apps
  • Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment and as a solo practitioner
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to professionally and successfully converse with clients, superiors, peers, and vendors

Physical Requirements:

  • Physically able to capture and detain individuals if necessary
  • Prolonged periods sitting of 5+ hours at a desk and monitoring surveillance equipment
  • Prolonged periods of standing on your feet without a break 4-5+ hours
  • Must be able to lift 50 pounds at a time
  • Must be able to lift, drag a human up to 200lbs or more, if necessary
  • Must be able to bend, twist, stoop, crawl
  • Being able to respond to physical attacks, natural disasters, evacuations
  • Perform physical activities such as hiking, biking, swimming

Salary

· $700/day

Employment with Keelson is at-will, meaning that you or Keelson may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice.

Keelson Strategic is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor under federal, state, or local law.

Keelson Strategic is licensed in the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services.

title: Senior Director, Data & Performance
description:
As theSenior Director of Data & Performance, you’ll lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of data systems, analytics tools, and performance reporting infrastructure for Acelero, Inc. This role ensures that the organization's data practices promote transparency, compliance, and strategic decision-making across Acelero Learning delegates and Shine Early Learning partners.

Why Acelero?

Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young childrenʼs inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor all of the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve.

Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities.

Your Role:

As a Senior Director you will manage a centralized team responsible for dashboard development, recurring and ad hoc reporting, and the integration of data systems across the network — and serve as the primary data partner to delegate leadership, including Delegate Vice Presidents, local Boards of Directors, and AHSGAC.

What You’ll Do:

Data Governance & Infrastructure

  • Establish and maintain organizational data governance frameworks, including data quality standards, ownership roles, documentation practices, and privacy safeguards.

  • Lead the development and management of end-to-end data lifecycle infrastructure — including ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, automation, and visualization — in collaboration with IT, ensuring seamless systems integration and automation across platforms to support scalable, real-time analytics and decision-making.

  • Maintain database structure, field alignment, and access protocols in collaboration with IT and database administrators to ensure data usability, reporting accuracy, and compliance with governance policies.

  • Ensure compliance with data privacy laws, security protocols, and internal risk mitigation measures.

Dashboard, Reporting & Analytics Oversight

  • Supervise the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organizational ecosystem of dashboards — including MBE, MBO, MBI, and AceleroStat — for internal teams, delegates, and external partners.

  • Oversee the production of recurring reports and custom analytics requests from internal teams, delegates, and Shine partners.

  • Ensure timely end-of-month reporting to the Office of Head Start, maintaining accuracy, completeness, and compliance with federal reporting requirements across all delegate programs.

  • Lead the scope, sequence, and fidelity of product development for the Annual Program Information Report (PIR) — ensuring the PIR reflects accurate program data, meets federal specifications, and is executed with consistency across the network.

  • Ensure readiness, accuracy, and completion of Head Start data submissions, including the PIR, Enrollment and Attendance Dashboards, and Federal Monitoring Review data requests.

  • Translate data into actionable insights and communicate performance findings clearly to executive audiences, including senior leadership and the Board of Directors.

Data Product Innovation & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead the design and development of new data and performance products that advance organizational decision-making, delegate accountability, and external reporting — moving beyond maintaining existing systems to actively identifying where new tools, visualizations, or analytical frameworks would create meaningful value.

  • Partner closely with the Product Team on the design, scoping, and development of data products — serving as the primary LIT voice on data architecture decisions, ensuring that products reflect how data is actually generated, used, and interpreted across the delegate network.

  • Bring an innovation lens to the full data and performance portfolio: regularly assess whether existing dashboards, reports, and data tools are still fit for purpose, and lead the process of retiring, replacing, or redesigning them when they are not.

  • Identify emerging technologies, analytical methodologies, and sector-wide data practices that could strengthen Acelero's data infrastructure, and make the case for adoption when the evidence warrants it.

  • Ensure that product development decisions are grounded in implementation reality — not theoretical design — by maintaining close feedback loops with Directors of Analysis, delegate leaders, and program staff who use data tools in practice.

Federal Planning & Needs Assessment Support

  • Provide data collection resources, infrastructure, and analytical support for Community Needs Assessment (CNA) updates and five-year grant renewal planning — ensuring data systems are positioned to generate the evidence base these processes require.

  • Collaborate with program leadership and delegate teams to ensure CNA and five-year update processes are grounded in timely, accurate, and well-organized data.

Delegate Engagement & Governance Interface

  • Serve as the primary data partner and liaison to delegate leadership, including Delegate Vice Presidents, local Boards of Directors, and AHSGAC, ensuring data and performance strategies align with local and organizational priorities.

  • Present performance data, insights, and strategic recommendations to AHSGAC and the Policy Council, ensuring transparency, accessibility, and relevance to governance decision-making.

  • Collaborate with Directors of Analysis to ensure data systems and dashboards reflect the realities and priorities of program operations across all service areas.

  • Participate actively in delegate start-up, expansion, and transition planning, ensuring alignment of data systems and infrastructure with implementation strategies and compliance requirements.

  • Represent the Data & Performance function in cross-delegate convenings, planning sessions, and the Annual Joint Board, Policy Council, and Staff Planning, Training, and Elections Event.

Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Oversee compliance-related reporting and dashboards that support Head Start monitoring, licensing, and internal audits.

  • Partner with the SD, Compliance & Program Fidelity to ensure compliance metrics are integrated with quality metrics in all reporting, and that data systems support corrective action monitoring and regulatory readiness.

  • Leverage data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities across service areas and delegate performance.

  • Lead standardization of reporting templates, data definitions, and KPIs across the organization to ensure consistent interpretation of key metrics.

  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of data documentation, including data dictionaries, SOPs, and internal guides to support recurring reporting, dashboard development, and compliance tracking.

Team Management & Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, overseeing work allocation, goal setting, project timelines, and professional development across the Data & Performance function.

  • Direct reports include: Manager, Data Design & Reporting; Specialist, Data Design & Reporting; Director of Analysis, CC; Director of Analysis, WW/MM; Director of Analysis, CP; Director of Analysis, DE/SC .

  • Establish formal feedback mechanisms with delegate leadership on satisfaction with Directors of Analysis and their teams, using insights to inform coaching and annual performance evaluations.

  • Build data literacy and data use capacity among delegate leaders and LIT staff through training, tools, and technical assistance.

Supervision

  • Supervises assigned department personnel including hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, and ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and completion of work performed by direct reports.

  • Meets with assigned staff regularly to identify and resolve problems, manage projects, track goals, and review work processes and procedures.

  • Represents team and/or department at meetings, events, and training as required.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in data science, analytics, education policy, or related field is a strong asset.

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in data analytics, performance management, or systems leadership.

  • At least three (3) years in a management or supervisory role, including leading cross-functional data teams.

  • Head Start, early education, public sector, or human services data experience is highly valued.

  • Experience in data governance, data pipeline development, or ETL processes.

  • Physical exam and background checks required.

  • Travel up to 10%, required for work-related meetings, training, and partner support.

  • Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

When/Where/How Much:

When: Summer 2026

Where: Remote with 10% travel

How Much: This positions pays up to $140,000 + comprehensive benefits package

Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

  • A meaningful mission that drives real change in the lives of children and families

  • A collaborative, inclusive team that values your growth and well-being

  • Robust benefits that support your total wellbeing, including:

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance with multiple plan options to fit your needs

    • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions up to $400/individuals & $800/family annually

    • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care expenses

    • 401(k) Retirement Plan with up to 3% company match

    • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance

    • Up to $500 per year in Professional Development Reimbursements

    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling and mental wellness support

    • Wellness Programs, including virtual fitness, nutrition, and mindfulness classes

    • Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, ID Theft Protection, and Employee Discount Perks

Why Join Acelero Learning?

At Acelero Learning and Shine Early Learning, we're committed to transforming early childhood education through innovation, continuous learning, and a relentless focus on quality. You'll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous improvement while making a meaningful impact on the educators who shape children's futures every day.

We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and healthy workplace.

We are seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Engineering Laboratory team—an exciting and highly specialized environment where products come to life. In this role, you won’t just design and build components—you will design and build the environments that test them. You’ll build and power the lab infrastructure, control systems, and simulation platforms that replicate real-world operating conditions for some of the most advanced aerospace systems in the world.

From jet engine fuel systems to electronic engine controls and environmental control systems, your work will directly enable innovation, validation, and mission success.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build advanced test environments that simulate real-world operating conditions for aerospace products including aircraft systems, Environmental Control Systems, jet engine fuel pumps, satellite thermal systems, propeller systems, and Electronic Engine Controls.

  • Lead the design, specification, procurement, and fabrication oversight of electrical power and control systems.

  • Develop and implement 3-phase power electronics and distribution systems, motor drives, temperature control, electric heaters (50–1000kW), and facility control systems.

  • Design and program PLC-based safety interlock systems and ladder logic controls.

  • Oversee installation, checkout, troubleshooting, and commissioning of complex test setups.

  • Create product interface wiring harnesses and electrical schematics.

  • Design systems for hazardous environments (ANSI/NFPA Class I, Div. 1).

  • Develop and optimize data acquisition and control systems for lab and flight test applications.

  • Measure and analyze key physical phenomena (temperature, pressure, mass flow, acceleration, speed, electrical properties, etc.) to support cutting-edge engineering product development..

  • Ensure compliance with NEC/NFPA 70 & 70E, including arc-flash considerations.

  • Collaborate with Lab Mechanical and Test Engineers to design, build, and operate state-of-the-art test facilities across various specialized labs (Pneumatic, Fuel, Hydro-Mechanical, Vibration, and Electronic).

What You Will Learn

  • Hands-on experience in Engineering R&D and product validation for cutting-edge aerospace products and systems.

  • Opportunity to design and build state-of-the-art engineering labs.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience

  • Experience in industrial, facilities, test/lab, or similar electrical engineering environments.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering.

  • Working experience with power systems, controls, and instrumentation.

  • Experience with PLC programming and automation systems.

  • Familiarity with LabVIEW, MATLAB, or other data acquisition environments.

  • Experience creating mechanical or electrical engineering drawings and schematics, using Microsoft Visio, AutoCAD, or SolidWorks

  • Knowledge of hazardous location design standards.

What We Offer

Some of our competitive benefits package includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees

  • Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option

  • Tuition reimbursement program

  • Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection

  • Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
