Health IT Data Engineer

Job Summary

Aptive is seeking a Health IT Data Engineer to provide advanced data engineering and analytics infrastructure support for the ICE Health Service Corps (IHSC) Health Information Technology Unit (HITU) IT modernization and enterprise data environments. This role designs, builds, configures, and maintains secure and reliable data pipelines, data structures, and integration workflows that enable analytics, reporting, and operational insight across IHSC clinical, operational, and administrative domains.

The Data Engineer performs scripted development using tools such as Python, SQL, and ETL/ELT frameworks; optimizes data models and schemas for reporting; and implements data validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes. All development, configuration, and implementation activities are conducted within authorized Government-managed platforms and environments under Government oversight, direction, and approval, with written authorization from the COR or designated Government technical representative required prior to deployment to production environments. This is a designated Key Personnel position under the contract.

The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with healthcare or enterprise data experience and can collaborate with Data Strategists, Data Analysts, and Solutions Developers to enable analytics and reporting while ensuring compliance with federal security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and store data from multiple internal and external systems.
  • Support enterprise analytics platforms by optimizing data models, schemas, and performance for reporting and dashboarding.
  • Implement data validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability of IHSC data assets.
  • Support integration of healthcare, operational, and administrative data sources in alignment with enterprise data strategy.
  • Collaborate with Data Strategists, Data Analysts, and Solutions Developers to enable analytics use cases and reporting requirements.
  • Maintain documentation for data architectures, pipelines, transformations, and dependencies.
  • Support data governance initiatives, including metadata management, auditability, and lineage tracking.
  • Ensure data solutions comply with federal security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with troubleshooting data issues and supporting operational continuity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with SQL, relational databases, and data modeling.
  • Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration workflows, including scripted development (e.g., Python).
  • Familiarity with cloud-based analytics and data platforms.
  • Understanding of healthcare or enterprise data environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work within Government oversight and approval processes, including obtaining written authorization prior to production deployment.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS/ICE fitness determination (public trust) and execute a DHS Non-Disclosure Agreement.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DHS, ICE, IHSC, or other federal healthcare IT or EHR modernization (EHRM) programs.
  • Experience with healthcare data domains and integration of clinical, operational, and administrative data sources.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, and data lineage tracking.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, and enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Experience building data solutions within Government-managed or otherwise controlled/regulated environments.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

Plan and perform a variety of cleaning and chemical processing operations to prepare parts for NDI, visual inspection, or return to service.

Work from operation sheets, Service Process Operation Procedures (SPOP), specifications, and written and verbal detailed instructions to perform standard chemical processing operations on items comprised of materials such as various steel, nickel, aluminum, and titanium alloys and other metals, plastics, and various composites. In accordance with established procedures, degrease and clean items using acid and alkali dipping or soaking operations, and cold or hot water rinses to strip or remove grease, dirt, scale, smut, and other surface residue as appropriate to perform specified cleaning operations or prepare items for subsequent inspection operations.

Use brush and/or scrubbing pad, pumice powder, and cold water to remove corrosion, stains, or other surface residue when necessary. Visually check parts for proper cleaning results and reprocess when needed. As required, mask items with tape, wax, or other coating. Load items into baskets and fixtures as appropriate. Set up equipment, process through the various preparatory solutions and immerse in tank; upon completion, rinse and dry. Check completed work visually for surface pitting, excessive etching, discoloration, voids, and blisters, stock removal, and surface hardness.

Assist higher grade technician with new, unusual, or large jobs requiring assistance to handle material, mask and position items on fixtures and in tank, and to complete miscellaneous reprocessing operations. Operate regeneration equipment to produce deionized water, maintain tank levels as necessary, help drain and refill the various processing tanks as directed, operate oven to bake parts when necessary, assist with the moving of materials and containers, using hoist, hand truck or fork lift to move and transport heavier items, and perform other related duties as required to facilitate chemical processing and surface cleaning functions.

This is a 3rd shift Opportunity. The hours are midnight - 6:30am, Monday-Friday. Standard Work Week is 32.5 Hours - Pay will be 40 Hours.

High School Diploma or GED

Requires a basic knowledge of the action of various chemicals upon different materials.

Also requires ability to work from drawings, operation sheets, specifications, and handbooks, the application of general surface treatment methods to developmental operations and specific problems. Prefer 6-12 months of trades training.

1+ years working on a clean or etch line.

Within the aviation industry preferred.

title: Credit Officer
description:
For SMV’er venter væksten ikke. Bliv den, der træffer de afgørende kreditbeslutninger

Alt for ofte bliver SMV’ers ambitioner mødt med tøven, tunge processer og forsinkelser. Sådan behøver det ikke være. Som vores nye Credit Officer forstår du forretningen, tror på den og bakker den op med den rette finansiering.

Det er en rolle med personligt mandat og komplekse cases, hvor du balancerer skarpe finansielle analyser med direkte forretningsindsigt.

Du bliver en del af et tæt, fagligt stærkt kreditteam på syv kolleger og den ene af i alt to dedikerede Credit Officers. I refererer begge direkte til vores Head of Credit, som leder med tillid, udvikling og frihed under ansvar.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du får ansvaret for hele kreditprocessen efter den første kundekontakt. Som faglig nøgleperson sikrer du hurtige og velfunderede kreditbeslutninger – så de rette SMV'er får et ja, de kan bygge videre på.

  • Selvstændig evaluering og godkendelse: Du foretager dybdegående finansielle analyser og godkender eller indstiller kreditengagementer inden for dit eget personlige mandat.
  • Forretningsnær sparring: Du er en proaktiv medspiller for vores erhvervskundechefer, hvor du udfordrer og sparrer om strukturen på de komplekse cases og finder de rette finansielle løsninger.
  • Byg processerne: Du er med til at strømline og bygge vores credit governance-værktøjer og kreditretningslinjer, så vi holder fast i den korte vej fra ansøgning til udbetaling – uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten. Her udnytter du vores cloud-infrastruktur til at skære unødigt bureaukrati væk og bygge en mere effektiv kreditafdeling.
  • Overvågning og porteføljepleje: Du overvåger løbende den eksisterende portefølje (herunder risikoklasse 2 og 3) og går i konstruktiv dialog for at hjælpe kunderne tilbage til en sund økonomi.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter en profil med solid indsigt i den finansielle sektor, stærk forretningsforståelse og flair for at spotte sunde muligheder i komplekse regnskaber. Din baggrund kan være mangfoldig. Vi forestiller os, at du enten:

  • Er en kreditstærk erhvervsrådgiver med solid erfaring i SMV-segmentet, som vil rykke tættere på selve kreditbeslutningen og governance-arbejdet.
  • Sidder i dag i en traditionel kreditafdeling, men savner kortere kommandoveje, en flad struktur og muligheden for reelt at præge processerne i hverdagen.
  • Har en baggrund som revisor eller revisorkandidat (fx HD(R) eller cand.merc.aud.) med stærk regnskabsforståelse og lyst til at omsætte teori til konkrete kreditgodkendelser.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Vil sætte retningen: Du motiveres af, at rammerne ikke altid er hugget i sten, og du har modet til at være arkitekten bag nye, smidige processer.
  • Er diplomatisk og kommerciel: Du spiller bold med erhvervskundecheferne, omfavner deres drive og sikrer, at der bliver sagt ja og nej på de helt rette tidspunkter.
  • Er en struktureret afslutter: Du har styr på detaljerne, holder deadlines og trives, når tempoet er højt.
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk: Du taler og skriver begge sprog på professionelt niveau.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos kompasbank kommer den største arbejdsglæde af tillid, høj faglighed og reel indflydelse. Du mærker hurtigt, at din indsats har direkte betydning for bankens resultater og retning.

  • Reelt ejerskab og indflydelse – direkte adgang til Head of Credit og ledelsen, hvor gode, gennemtænkte argumenter trumfer tunge hierarkier.
  • Attraktiv løn og pension, 6 ugers ferie og sundhedsforsikring.
  • 70+ dygtige og rare kolleger.
  • Moderne kontor i Vedbæk i grønne omgivelser tæt på kysten.
  • Løbende lærings- og udviklingsmuligheder.
  • Fri adgang til fitness på campus, månedlige sociale events og torsdagsbar.

Om kompasbank

Vores formål er enkelt: at forløse SMV’ernes potentiale. 25 millioner europæiske SMV’er er underservicerede af traditionelle banker, og det hul lukker vi. Vi er en cloud-native bank med fuld EU-banklicens, bygget fra bunden uden legacy-systemer og tunge beslutningsprocesser. Det gør os hurtige og fleksible, når SMV'er i Danmark og resten af Europa har brug for adgang til finansiering og finansielle services.

Siden lanceringen i august 2021 har vi ekspanderet i Danmark, Tyskland og Spanien. I 2025 voksede vi med +75 % i kunder, og vi er blandt andet kåret som Best Bank for SMEs – Denmark af FDI Insider.

🚀 Vores vision er at bygge Europas beslutsomme bank for SMV’er – én der forstår forretningen, tror på den og bakker den op.

Ansøgning og proces

Vi afvikler samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Forventet opstart er den 1. oktober 2026.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Responsibilities

About the Role

Own the infrastructure that keeps everything running, and clear the path for everyone who depends on it.

As a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer at Hummingbird, you’ll independently lead complex infrastructure, integration, and automation work across our technology environment. You’ll spend most of your day designing and maintaining our Azure infrastructure, building integrations and automation, and serving as the go-to escalation point when technical issues rise above the service desk. You’ll translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions, keep our systems secure and stable, and help teammates grow along the way.

This role is a natural fit for a well-rounded engineer who has worked across many technologies rather than a single narrow lane, who takes initiative without waiting for direction, and who genuinely enjoys partnering with people across the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead implementation of complex integrations, automation workflows, and system connections, including work without clear precedent.

  • Own and organize Hummingbird’s Azure infrastructure, improving cost efficiency, consistency, and alignment to best practices.

  • Serve as the escalation point for the service desk on technical issues, including Microsoft application support such as SharePoint.

  • Build integrations that automate manual work, such as provisioning roles and licenses across systems.

  • Support our citizen development program by building and maintaining the infrastructure behind internally built apps.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex, cross-system issues by tracing root causes across interconnected platforms.

  • Strengthen system integrity and security within your scope, including access controls and validation approaches.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting, documentation, and day-to-day engineering work.

  • Maintain clear documentation of system logic, configurations, integrations, and dependencies.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar on standards for version control, testing, change management, and documentation.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent Internet service.

  • Work Type: Full-time

  • Compensation: Expected range is $120,800 to $157,000. New hires usually start between $120,800 and $145,000, depending on experience and internal equity.

  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more

Required & Desired Skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 4 to 5+ years of independent delivery in information systems, cybersecurity, IT, computer science, or a related technical discipline, including work in moderately ambiguous contexts.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, cloud environments, and enterprise systems administration.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-system implementation and integration work from requirements through production, and resolving issues that span multiple platforms.

  • Solid understanding of security concepts, including access controls, authentication, IAM, and compliance frameworks.

  • Experience designing automation that reduces manual effort and strengthens reliability.

  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools as a core part of how you work, and openness to adopting new ones.

  • A self-directed approach with strong initiative; you frame problems and move work forward without waiting for direction.

  • Clear communication and a collaborative, people-first style, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical partners alike.

Nice to Have

  • Telephony experience, ideally with Genesys, or the ability to build and support telephony integrations.

  • Background at a managed service provider or another environment that exposed you to a broad range of technologies, from infrastructure and networking to application support.

  • Experience with scripting languages, API development, or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.

  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team.

A Note on Authentic Interviews

We believe the best hiring conversations are real ones. Notes are welcome, and jotting things down during the call is completely fine. What we ask is that you don’t use AI tools or similar assistance to generate your responses in real time. We’re genuinely trying to get to know you: how you think, how you communicate, and what you’ve experienced. That connection matters to us, and it’s hard to find when answers are scripted rather than interactive.

We’re a team that makes healthcare more human. We’d love to meet the person behind your application.

Expectations for Focus & Presence

  • To support patients and each other, this role requires your full attention during scheduled work hours. Our Outside Employment Policy doesn’t allow overlapping work or “job stacking,” so any outside work must happen fully outside your Hummingbird schedule.

  • We’re a camera-ready team, and you’ll need to be on camera during training and when needed during the workday after training ends.

  • We value connection, teamwork, and being present, which is what keeps our patients safe and our team supported. If that’s what you’re looking for, you’ll feel at home here. If you’re hoping to hold another job during the same hours, this job won’t be the best match.

Growth at Hummingbird

This role is a key part of our technology team. You’ll take on increasingly complex infrastructure, integration, and automation challenges over time, deepen your expertise across our Azure environment, and help shape how the team works as it grows. You’ll receive coaching and feedback along the way. At Hummingbird, we believe good jobs should lead somewhere, and that starts here.

Please Note: The seniority level of this position may be adjusted during the recruitment process based on candidate skills and experience.

The Hummingbird Approach
We value a team that brings diverse perspectives and experiences to the work we do. While there are many ways to do this, people who are successful at Hummingbird:

  • Lead with Respect by valuing kindness and working to actively foster an environment of inclusion and respect.
  • Embrace Growth and seek out learning and growth for themselves and support those around them in their growth journey. They bring curiosity and an openness to innovation to all their interactions.
  • Bring a Win Together mentality by approaching conflict directly, listening carefully, and seeking to understand. They problem-solve with the goal of finding successes, not trade-offs, for all involved.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Hummingbird Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We value the talents of individuals from all backgrounds and actively seek a diverse workforce.

Our mission is to provide a fair and inclusive recruitment process for everyone, and reasonable accommodations are available to any applicant who may need them. Please reach out to talent@hummingbird.healthcare to request accommodations and we’d be happy to chat.

title: Crew Leader
description:
Job Title: Crew Leader

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026

Job Summary:

The Crew Leader provides support and coaching to the crew to achieve production goals. This role identifies safety hazards and ensures compliance along with task allocation and prioritization of work on the job site as directed by their General Foreperson.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Adheres to and coaches employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods, and OSHA regulations. Assists with conducting necessary safety training, pre-job briefings, designating crew member assignments and coaching in accordance with company policies, procedures, and customer requirements.

  • Uses applicable herbicide equipment to treat stumps and brush. Maintain appropriate application records.

  • Obtains permission from property owners to trim or remove trees and apply herbicides. Works with customer or property owner to gain access to the job site, advises of potential interruption, and explains the work needing to be completed.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and in close proximity to energized power lines.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Conducts pre-inspection of work area to identify potential hazards.

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Promotes and maintains good customer and public relations through effective completion of assigned work and the appropriate behavior of employees on the crew.

  • Maintains records, and reports related to the production of the crew, such as timesheets, work orders, units of work, manhours, distribution of crew assignments and controlling costs, to meet organizational goals.

  • Obtains and interprets maps from General Foreperson or utility showing work orders to be completed for tree trimming, removals and chemical application. Responsible for understanding drawings and symbols representing types of power lines, voltages, and line equipment per industry standard and assisting General Foreperson with assigning daily work orders.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Staging and clean-up of tools and equipment at the job site. Maintains a neat and orderly work area.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster. Assists with contacting and coordinating the crew’s response to such work and responsible for determining proper steps necessary to eliminate hazards and trim/remove trees while onsite during emergency response.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Possess excellent leadership skills and be able to handle stressful situations along with being able to multi-task.

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and educate on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to write, read, and comprehend written and verbal job instructions/information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 3 years’ experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

Language Requirements (read, write, speak):

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Spanish - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Other Language _________________ - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Travel Requirements:

☐No-Seldom

☐Yes-Occasional (up to 5%)

☐Yes-Moderate (5% to 25%)

☐Yes-Substantial (25% to 50%)

☒Yes-Extensive (greater than 50%)

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Cargo: Crew Leader

Tipo de salario: No exento

Fecha de creación/Fecha de revisión: 04/24/2026

Resumen del puesto:

El Crew Leader brinda apoyo y orientación al equipo de trabajo para alcanzar los objetivos de producción. La persona en este puesto identifica los posibles factores de riesgo a la seguridad y garantiza el cumplimiento de las normas, además de asignar tareas y priorizar el trabajo en el lugar de trabajo según las indicaciones de su General Foreperson.

Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Cumple con y orienta a los empleados sobre las políticas de la empresa, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de OSHA. Ayuda a impartir la capacitación en seguridad necesaria, realiza reuniones informativas previas al trabajo (job briefings), asigna tareas a los miembros del equipo de trabajo y brinda orientación conforme a las políticas, procedimientos y requisitos del cliente.

  • Utiliza equipos de aplicación de herbicidas según corresponda para tratar trocos y maleza (brush). Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.

  • Obtiene permisos de los propietarios para podar o eliminar árboles y aplicar herbicidas. Trabaja con el cliente o propietario para obtener acceso al lugar de trabajo, informa sobre posibles interrupciones y explica el trabajo que debe realizarse.

  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y en proximidad a líneas eléctricas energizadas.

  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.

  • Realiza inspecciones previas del área de trabajo para identificar posibles riesgos.

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.

  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.

  • Promueve y mantiene buenas relaciones con clientes y público mediante la correcta realización del trabajo asignado y el comportamiento apropiado de los empleados del equipo de trabajo.

  • Mantiene registros e informes relacionados con la producción del equipo de trabajo, como hojas de horas, órdenes de trabajo, unidades de producción, horas-hombre, distribución de tareas y control de costos, con el fin de cumplir los objetivos organizacionales.

  • Recibe e interpreta los mapas del General Foreperson o de la empresa de servicios públicos que muestran las órdenes de trabajo que deben completarse para la poda y la eliminación de árboles o la aplicación química. Es responsable de comprender los planos y símbolos que representan los tipos de líneas eléctricas, tensiones y equipos de líneas eléctricas según los estándares del sector, y de asistir al General Foreperson en la asignación de las órdenes de trabajo diarias.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Se encarga de la preparación y limpieza de herramientas y equipos en el lugar de trabajo. Mantiene un área de trabajo limpia y ordenada.

  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento. Colabora en la comunicación y coordinación de la respuesta del equipo de trabajo ante dichas situaciones, y es responsable de determinar los pasos adecuados para eliminar peligros y podar o retirar árboles durante las labores de respuesta.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de propiedad de empleados de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.

  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con el público, los clientes y los empleados.

  • Capacidad para cumplir y enseñar los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.

  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.

  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.

  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

Factores ambientales:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer – Observability
description:
Introduction to Role

Are you ready to harness observability to keep world-scale science running at pace? Could you lead the strategy that helps researchers trust the platforms behind computational chemistry, genomics and AI-driven discovery while raising your own profile through visible, high-impact work?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer focused on Observability, you will shape how our Scientific Computing Platform is monitored and understood, turning signals into insights that prevent incidents and accelerate research. You will evolve our current Prometheus and Grafana landscape and guide a multi-year shift toward an enterprise-grade observability capability using commercial tooling such as Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, or Grafana Cloud — ensuring we can scale confidently as demand grows.

This hands-on senior role sits within a collaborative, globally distributed platform engineering team operating across cloud-native services and large-scale bare-metal estates. You will combine automation, reliability engineering, and deep telemetry expertise so scientists can compute with confidence and get treatments to patients faster.

Accountabilities

  • Observability Platform Ownership: Operate, improve, and scale the Prometheus and Grafana stack on Kubernetes; define alerting strategies and build actionable dashboards that cut time-to-detection and time-to-recovery for critical services.

  • Migration and Future Tooling: Lead our contribution to the centralized enterprise observability initiative; evaluate and prepare for adoption of commercial platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana Cloud), building a clear path from today's stack to tomorrow's shared capability.

  • Automation and GitOps: Increase reliability and repeatability through GitOps workflows and CI/CD pipelines; automate deployments and configuration to reduce manual effort and eliminate drift across environments.

  • Platform Administration: Administer Ansible, Vault, Consul, Prometheus, and Grafana to underpin configuration, secrets management, monitoring, and observability functions across cloud and HPC estates.

  • Incident Response and Resilience: Own high-severity incident response for the platform; drive root-cause analysis and implement improvements that raise availability, performance, and customer trust.

  • Monitoring and Alerting: Establish proactive monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting that give full-stack visibility and enable data-driven performance tuning and capacity planning.

  • Engineering Best Practices: Evaluate and introduce emerging tools and practices that strengthen DevOps processes, improve developer experience, and advance platform capabilities.

  • Documentation and Enablement: Produce clear, durable documentation and runbooks; enable platform users and partner teams to self-serve and build with confidence.

  • Mentoring: Coach junior engineers and champion a culture of learning, openness, and continuous improvement across a distributed team.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Strong experience with observability tooling and platforms — Prometheus, Grafana, and ideally one or more commercial APM/observability platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, or Grafana Cloud).
  • Experience with application performance monitoring (APM), distributed tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Solid DevOps and platform engineering background: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), GitOps workflows, and shell scripting.
  • Experience with configuration management and platform tooling such as Ansible, Vault, or Consul.
  • Understanding of cloud technologies and engineering paradigms (AWS preferred but not exclusive).
  • Experience using AI tooling to accelerate engineering delivery and improve quality.
  • Familiarity with product-centric delivery models, DevOps culture, and Agile methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable working in a globally distributed team across multiple time zones.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Experience operating or supporting high-performance computing (HPC) environments at scale — large server fleets, high-throughput storage, and workload scheduling (SLURM, LSF, or similar).
  • Familiarity with the Grafana observability stack beyond core Grafana: Loki, Tempo, Mimir.
  • Background or curiosity in biology, medicine, or scientific computing in a pharma/R&D context.
  • Experience migrating between observability platforms or contributing to enterprise-wide tooling standardization efforts.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca

Here, your engineering will power real science — placing platform experts shoulder-to-shoulder with researchers to turn complex telemetry into decisions that speed discovery for patients. You will work with advanced HPC and cloud-native technologies, collaborate with diverse specialists, and help set enterprise standards for observability during a pivotal transformation. We encourage curiosity and evidence-led innovation, value kindness alongside ambition, and provide opportunities to showcase your work — whether presenting internally, contributing to communities, or publishing insights — so you grow your impact as you grow your craft.

Step into a role where your observability vision will shape enterprise platforms and accelerate breakthrough science — send your application and help build what's next!

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Open LMS) UK, Remote
description:
Role Description

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our team and help build, scale, and evolve our multi-tenant SaaS hosting platform on AWS. Our platform dynamically provisions, manages, and scales hundreds of Moodle LMS instances for education clients — powered by custom orchestration tooling, distributed service discovery, and infrastructure as code.

This is a hands-on infrastructure role. You'll work across the full stack — from Terraform modules and Puppet manifests to Python automation and observability pipelines. The platform is not containerised — there is no Kubernetes here — so we're looking for someone who understands Linux systems deeply and can reason about distributed systems problems from first principles.

You'll have real ownership and influence over the platform's architecture and direction as we continue to grow and evolve the infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Designing, building, and maintaining AWS infrastructure using Terraform (EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, Lambda, ALB, ElastiCache, Route 53, VPC networking)
  • Writing and maintaining Puppet modules to configure and manage fleets of EC2 instances across multiple auto-scaling groups
  • Maintaining and extending Python-based automation and tooling that supports platform operations
  • Operating and improving distributed service discovery and configuration management (etcd)
  • Managing and tuning a multi-tier caching strategy (Varnish, Redis/Valkey, PHP OPcache)
  • Running and scaling our observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Fluentd, PagerDuty) and participating in on-call rotations
  • Evaluating and implementing distributed storage solutions as the platform evolves
  • Improving deployment workflows and release processes
  • Collaborating with internal teams on API contracts, integration patterns, and operational tooling
  • Participating in incident response, root cause analysis, and platform reliability improvements

Skills and Aptitudes

  • Strong experience with AWS services in production — particularly EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, Lambda, ALB, ElastiCache, Route 53, IAM, and VPC networking
  • Proficiency in authoring and maintaining Terraform modules for production infrastructure
  • Proficiency in authoring and maintaining Puppet modules (or equivalent agent-based configuration management) for fleet management
  • Solid Python skills — you'll be writing and maintaining production daemons, not just scripts
  • Deep Linux systems knowledge (Ubuntu) — comfortable with Apache/Nginx, PHP-FPM, Varnish, systemd, filesystem mounts, and networking fundamentals
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts: consensus, leader election, distributed locking, eventual consistency, and the tradeoffs involved
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining observability pipelines (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or equivalent) in production
  • Comfortable working in a GitLab-based CI/CD workflow
  • Clear communicator who can document architectural decisions and explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Additionally, a Top Candidate Will Exhibit One or More of the Following Preferred Qualifications

title: AI Video Creator
description:
Our mission at Ello is simple and urgent: maximize the potential of every child, everywhere. We're building the world's first AI teacher to close that gap: one that listens, speaks, adapts, and inspires, just like the best human educators.

Our first product, Read with Ello, is already helping tens of thousands of kids each week learn to read. It listens as they read aloud, offers support when they stumble, and generates magical, personalized stories. It works, and kids love it.

Now, we're scaling that success into something even bigger: a complete AI teacher that can help children learn far beyond reading. Our new app combines language, speech, and memory to deliver interactive learning for kids worldwide; check it out here. We're moving fast: we ship weekly, test directly with kids, and push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in education.

With the resources of the world's top investors and the heart of a public benefit corporation, we're here to revolutionize how children learn globally. Featured on TIME's Best Inventions and Fortune's Change the World, Ello is a small, mission-driven team taking on one of the most important challenges of our time: to democratize education.

About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of AI creative production and learning design. You'll take a lesson objective and outline from our curriculum team and turn it into images, animations, and short videos that make a lesson feel alive for a 4-8 year old — using the fastest-moving AI generation tools available today. We're looking for a full-time contractor with at least 30 hours/week available.

This isn't a “receive a brief, execute it” role. You'll build the pipelines that let us generate this content fast without sacrificing quality, and you'll partner directly with a subject matter expert to shape activities that actually teach, not just entertain. We're building from the ground up, so you'll be defining what “AI-generated learning content” looks like at Ello as much as producing it.

What You'll Do

  • Create high-quality images, animations, and video clips using AI tools (Midjourney, Sora, Veo, RunwayML, Stable Diffusion, Magnific, Suno, ChatGPT, etc.)

  • Build and refine pipelines to generate assets at a fast pace without sacrificing quality

  • Edit and assemble AI-generated content into polished, final videos ready to ship into a lesson

  • Design scalable visual and interactive patterns that map to the skillset our AI tutor actually has available

  • Take a lesson objective and outline and turn it into engaging images and short videos that hit the mark

  • Partner with a subject matter expert to design learning activities for kids that balance challenge, fun, and real-world relevance

Key Requirements

  • You're an expert in AI video, image, and audio generation tools (Midjourney, Sora, Veo, RunwayML, Stable Diffusion, Magnific, Suno, ChatGPT, etc.), and you're quick to pick up new ones as they ship

  • You have a strong design sensibility and effectively leverage AI tools to bring your vision to life

  • You have a portfolio that shows you can turn a rough idea into something visually compelling — AI-generated or otherwise, education-related or not

  • You have a real, specific way AI tools have changed how you work — not just "I use AI sometimes," but a workflow or pipeline you've built or adopted recently and what it changed

  • You're energized by zero-to-one environments, iterating quickly based on real product feedback rather than a finished spec

  • You're self-directed and collaborative — you can take a lesson objective and figure out the rest

Nice to Have

  • Experience with traditional video editing software (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar)

  • Background in math, early literacy, ESL, or bilingual education

  • Content creation experience (social platforms, children's media) with a track record of strong engagement

  • Familiarity with instructional design or child development principles

  • Experience teaching or working directly with kids

We look for candidates who

  • Are genuinely excited about helping kids learn — not just about the craft of AI-generated media

  • Move fast and don't need every detail pre-defined for them

  • Give and take direct feedback well; we're building this in real time and need people who improve the work, not just execute a brief

  • Are honest about what's working and what isn't, including with each other

Reasons to join us

  • Play with the newest AI creative tools before most studios have even touched them — on lessons real kids use the next day

  • Do work that directly shapes how millions of children could learn to read, do math, and love learning

  • Be one of the earliest people defining what AI-generated learning content looks like at Ello

  • Flexible, remote, async-friendly work

About Ello

Ello is a public benefit corporation on a mission to maximize the potential of all children. We're currently around ~50 people, headquartered in San Francisco with a second office in Nairobi, Kenya.

Our team has deep expertise in artificial intelligence, K-12 education, and child development across institutions such as Stanford, Berkeley, Google, Apple, and more. We were part of Y Combinator's W20 batch and are funded by world-class investors including Goodwater Capital, Homebrew, Reed Hastings, Common Sense Growth, Ravensburger, Project A Ventures, Reach Capital, Khosla Ventures, WndrCo, Visible Ventures, and K9 Ventures.

We're a small, collaborative team that takes each other's voices very seriously. Because our mission is to support all children, it is critical that our team is representative of the communities we work in; we place significant emphasis on ensuring diversity in our team and inclusion in our culture. If you have questions about immigration, reach out to us at recruiting@ello.com.

We feel enormously privileged to be building at this moment. Advances in AI have made it possible, for the first time, to imagine giving every child a truly personalized teacher. We don't take that opportunity for granted.

We work with urgency because millions of children can't wait. We care deeply about craftsmanship because learning experiences should feel magical. And we believe it's possible to build ambitious technology while building a company where people do the best work of their careers.

If that excites you, we'd love to meet you.

At Ello, diversity is a moral imperative and a competitive advantage. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, skin color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We plan and structure our interviews to assess skills and experience directly. If you need accommodations throughout the interview process, please contact recruiting@ello.com.

description:

At Knutson, opportunities to shine happen daily. We value what makes you different and empower you to act on your ideas.

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) serves as Knutson Construction’s enterprise leader for technology strategy, vision, integration, transformation, and governance. This role is responsible for shaping how technology enables business performance, supports growth, and strengthens differentiation across markets. The CTO integrates IT, data & analytics, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence (AI) into a cohesive enterprise capability that enhances operational execution, risk management, and The Knutson Experience (TKE).

This role partners closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Operations, Finance, Safety, and Market Sector Leadership to align technology investments and capabilities with Knutson’s strategic priorities, while reinforcing the company’s Zero Incident Safety Culture and commitment to continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Technology Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to the President and Executive Leadership Team on strategic enterprise technology direction, priorities, investments, opportunities, and risks.
  • Translate Knutson’s strategic plan into an integrated technology roadmap across IT, data, AI, and cybersecurity, ensuring technology alignment with enterprise goals, growth and risk tolerance.

Data, Analytics & AI Leadership

  • Advance analytics and AI capabilities by identifying, prioritizing, and scaling use cases that enhance project delivery, decision-making, and risk management.
  • Enable a data-driven organization by promoting adoption of analytics, reporting, and insights across all functions and levels.

  • Evaluate and manage external vendors, partners, and service providers.

Oh yeah, did we mention perks? We know that benefits matter and that is why we offer a competitive benefits package for all eligible employees.

Job Description

Location: Oklahoma City - 123 Robert S Kerr Avenue

Salary: up to $67,600.00, based on education and experience

Full Time /Part Time: Full Time

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday

Primary Hours: 8-5

Position Summary

This position will perform duties in support of the statutorily required duties of the Sexual Health and Harm Reduction Service. This position is responsible for conducting active and passive surveillance activities for STIs, including syphilis, chlamydia, and gonorrhea. The STI Surveillance Epidemiologist will be utilizing multiple software tools (SAS, SQL, MS Excel, Power BI, etc.) to perform data linkages, quality assurance, and analysis. This position will also support the HIV Prevention and Surveillance efforts by assisting with data analysis required for syndemic response in Oklahoma.

Position Responsibilities /Essential Functions

  • Review STI laboratory tests for possible new infections or missing laboratory results/information.
  • Review, classify and close completed STI cases.
  • Assist with the data quality assurance activities across all STIs including, but not limited to, follow up on priority cases where no treatment is documented.
  • Assist with presentations regarding the basic epidemiological information for STIs.
  • Analyze basic surveillance data using SAS, SQL, Microsoft Excel or other software programs.
  • Assist in processing data requests; providing clear and concise results.
  • Assist with program evaluation by providing data collection and analysis.
  • Receives, reviews and compiles complex statistical data; compiles and edits data for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepares and arranges statistical tables and charts for compilation into manuals, handbooks, reports and dashboards. Assist in creation of tables and graphs to be posted on the agency website/dashboards.
  • Analyzes and interprets data, using statistical research programs or other methods, and makes projections based on statistical inference.
  • Participate in the Congenital Syphilis Review Board and Task Force meetings.
  • Follow-up on specified gonorrhea cases to obtain key information for the enhanced gonorrhea surveillance project through patient and/or provider interview.
  • Being present in the office is an essential function of the position.

Other Duties

  • Demonstrates knowledge of and supports mission, vision, value statements, standards, policies and procedures, operating instructions, confidentiality standards, and the code of ethical behavior.
  • Works effectively in team environment, participating and assisting their peers.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Education and Experience

Requirements at this level consist of a master’s degree in public health, statistics, mathematics, or health science which includes 6 semester hours in epidemiological or statistical methods and 6 semester hours of other epidemiological or statistical coursework and 9 semester hours in statistical or epidemiological analysis.

Valued Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Ability to read, write, and communicate clearly and to perform simple arithmetic problems and operate basic computer programs such as Microsoft Excel and Word. Ability is required to write simple reports; to follow oral or written instructions; and to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others. Ability is required at this level include knowledge of epidemiology methods, human biology, laboratory methods, environmental analyses interpretation, parasitology, toxicology, immunology and pathology; of medical terminology; of statistical analysis, biometry, and demography; of epidemiological or statistical software; of social and economic conditions; and of current epidemiological developments and techniques. Ability is required to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others; to meet with the public and conduct public information programs; to write technical and non-technical information material; and to use a personal computer and applicable software.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Work is typically performed in an office setting with a climate controlled settings and exposure to moderate noise level. While performing the duties of the job, employee is required to talk, stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. This position requires long period of sitting and daily use of computer and phone. Some work related travel is required.

title: Finance Business Partner - Lung
description:
Finance Business Partner - Lung

Are you ready to turn financial insight into decisive action that accelerates impact for people living with lung cancer? Do you thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy, rigorous P&L management, and clear, evidence-based decision-making?

In this role, you will be the strategic finance partner to our US Lung franchise, shaping plans that fuel growth, sharpening forecast accuracy, and unlocking resources where they matter most. You will bring clarity to complexity—connecting KPIs, P&L dynamics, inventory, and gross-to-net to the realities of market execution—so leaders can move faster with confidence.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with cross-functional partners in Commercial, Trade Operations, Insights and Analytics, and Finance to surface opportunities, mitigate risks, and embed best practices. By applying advanced modelling and smart use of digital and AI tools, you will simplify how we plan, strengthen how we invest, and help the business deliver for patients today while building for tomorrow.

Accountabilities:

  • Financial Planning and Strategy: Lead development of periodic financial and strategic plans for the Lung franchise, aligning resources to priority growth opportunities and long-term objectives.
  • P&L Ownership: Drive end-to-end P&L management with a focus on forecast accuracy, disciplined cost control, and efficient resource allocation to maximize performance and value creation.
  • Performance Reporting and Insight: Oversee KPI and core financial reporting (P&L, inventory, gross-to-net) and translate results into clear, actionable insights that inform commercial choices.
  • Monthly Business Reviews: Lead monthly submissions from the US market to the Global Oncology Business Unit, ensuring complete, accurate, and timely deliverables supported by robust analysis.
  • Forecasting Excellence: Own planning and forecasting processes in close collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, delivering consistent, ambitious, and assumption-driven plans.
  • Results Challenge and Course-Correction: Evaluate and challenge financial results, track progress versus budget and forecast, and recommend corrective actions to improve delivery.
  • Commercial Partnership: Partner closely with business leaders to understand performance drivers and tactics, identify risks and opportunities, and build robust business cases that guide investment.
  • Reporting Landscape Improvement: Proactively assess and evolve performance reporting in partnership with the US Lung Senior Finance Director and peers, driving simplification and impact.
  • Strategic Finance Interface: Serve as the connective tissue between Franchise Commercial and Finance, ensuring tools, processes, and insights enable fast, high-quality decisions.
  • Process Simplification and Automation: Identify and lead improvements across the planning journey and related operations, leveraging digital and AI capabilities to boost efficiency and transparency.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in financial management, FP&A, or finance business partnering.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to execute and deliver in a dynamic environment.
  • Advanced financial modelling capability, including the ability to evaluate scenarios, assess risks, and support strategic decisions.
  • Well-developed business acumen, with a strong understanding of commercial and financial drivers.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • MBA, CPA, CFA, or similar advanced qualification
  • Prior experience in Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech
  • Ability to lead large-scale processes, enterprise initiatives, or complex cross-functional projects.
  • Strong digital, AI, and Systems acumen

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Here, finance is a performance catalyst—powering smarter decisions, faster execution, and better outcomes for patients. You will join a high-performing, digitally savvy team that blends data, design thinking, and real-world insight to improve how the enterprise runs and invests. We bring unexpected teams together to solve tough problems, take balanced risks, and turn ideas into impact, all while staying grounded in ethics and transparency. Your contribution will shape how we scale life-changing science, and you will grow alongside colleagues who value kindness alongside ambition and collaboration alongside accountability.

Step into this opportunity to shape the Lung franchise’s financial strategy and accelerate your impact—express your interest today and help us turn sharp analysis into meaningful outcomes for patients.

The annual base pay (or hourly rate of compensation) for this position ranges from $122,760 to $184,140. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

title: Executive Protection Agent
description:

Job Summary:
This is an unarmed Executive Protection Agent position in which the candidate will alternate between executive protection responsibilities and driving duties. The role requires both domestic and international travel. Candidates must be comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and in social settings involving high-profile public figures.

Ideal candidates will have prior experience supporting C-suite executives and the ability to integrate smoothly into that environment.   • Ensure the overall safety and security of designated Principals and their property
  • Monitoring of multiple security systems to include alarms and cameras, and competence to identify and properly act on security risks
  • Controlling access to properties and maintenance of security logs for guests, service personnel, and vendors

  • Capable of on-the-spot critical thinking and improvisation
  • STRONG emotional intelligence and self-awareness
  • Must be comfortable in a variety of social settings, with ability to socially engineer desired outcomes
  • Must be willing to submit to pre-employment, post-accident and random drug testing as determined by management
  • Working shifts that can include days/nights/weekends/holidays/OT
  • Travel when required, both domestic and international
  • Provide close protection to Principals at various venues, events, business meetings, personal trips, etc.
  • Performing a variety of tasks around the Principal’s property as required
  • Agents must maintain a positive attitude through a wide variety of situations, as well as, must conduct themselves in a manner which contribute to a positive and professional work environment

  • Agent must be proficient in defensive tactics, in order to deescalate, or actively engage in potential threats against the Principals

  • Clocking in/out for work shifts

Position Certificates and Licenses:

  • A Valid United States Driver’s License
  • Current Passport with more than six months expiration
  • CPR/First Aid/AED certification for Adults, Children, and Infants

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Associates or bachelor’s degree
  • Or certification from a recognized EP school (this can be supplemented with 2+ years of relevant industry experience)
  • Graduation from a certified driving school is also preferrable, but this too can be supplemented based on experience
  • Military or Law enforcement experience is a plus
  • Proficient in the use of social media collection tools in support of protective intelligence
  • Prior RST experience a plus
  • Training in defensive tactics, counter surveillance/surveillance detection, and covert protection experience
  • Active First Responder, Paramedic or EMT certifications a plus
  • Regularly active in outdoor activities such as mountain biking, hiking, ocean sports, etc.
  • California CCW permit is a plus

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Must possess a good understanding of the latest technology in security camera systems, use of smartphones, communications, and collaboration apps
  • Must be able to work in a collaborative team environment
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to professionally and successfully converse with clients, superiors, peers, and vendors
  • Drug free; must pass a drug screening and submit to periodic screenings throughout employment
  • Specific training related to this specific detail will be provided upon hire

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to patrol the property and access areas quickly
  • Physically able to capture and detain individuals if necessary
  • Prolonged periods sitting of 5+ hours at a desk and monitoring surveillance equipment
  • Prolonged periods of standing on your feet without a break 4-5+ hours
  • Must be able to lift 50 pounds at a time
  • Must be able to lift, drag a human up to 200lbs or more, if necessary
  • Must be able to bend, twist, stoop, crawl
  • Being able to respond to physical attacks, natural disasters, evacuations
  • Perform physical activities such as hiking, biking, swimming

Salary and Benefits:

Travel-In Position, live anywhere in the US

    • $161,000 minimum annual compensation
    • Guaranteed overtime pay in accordance with CA state law and Federal law
    • Paid sick leave
    • Paid time off (PTO) accrual
    • Holiday pay for select holidays you work (6)
    • Company 401(k) with employer match
    • Flexible insurance plans - Medical, dental and vision
    • 100% of employee premium paid for by Keelson (plan upgradable for additional employee paid premium)
    • Generous employer contribution per family member (up to 4 family members) to help lower employee contributions for dependents that join the plan
    • Life Insurance
    • Long Term Disability
    • Short Term Disability
    • Critical Accident/Illness coverage

    Employment with Keelson is at-will, meaning that you or Keelson may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice.

title: General Foreperson - Travel Pod
description:
Salary: $82,160

Division 15

Job Title: General Foreperson

Pay Rate Type: Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026

Job Summary:

The General Foreperson provides support and coaching to the crew to achieve production goals. This role identifies safety hazards and ensures compliance along with task allocation and prioritization of work on the job site as directed by their Project Manager.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Provides direct oversight and supervision of line clearance crew members. Including, but not limited to employee work assignments, interpretation and application of Union Agreements, performance management and coaching in accordance with company policies, procedures, and customer requirements.

  • Adheres to, trains and coaches employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods, and OSHA regulations.

  • Conducts necessary safety training, stand downs, and pre-job briefings. Engages Safety Education Training team to coordinate additional training initiatives to address areas of opportunity and concern.

  • Collaborates with Human Resources regarding employment for crew members including, but not limited to, hiring, discipline, separation of employment, leaves of absence – FMLA/ADA, as well as policy overall enforcement. Must understand Form I-9 process and proper interviewing techniques as well as exercise fair and reasonable judgment working through employee relations matters.

  • Obtains and interprets maps from the utility showing work orders to be completed for tree trimming, removals and chemical application. Responsible for understanding drawings and symbols representing types of power lines, voltages, and line equipment per industry standard and assigning daily work orders.

  • Responsible for maintaining records, and reports related to the production of the crew, such as timesheets, work orders, units of work, manhours, distribution of crew assignments and locations.

  • Responsible for controlling costs, including effective use of manpower, work methods, proper amount of trimming, and operation of equipment to meet organizational goals.

  • Works closely with internal departments to support accident investigations, property damage claims, truck breakdowns and workers compensation claims. May be a designated representative to settle minor claims.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools and request major repairs and replacements when necessary.

  • Maintains knowledge of new equipment specifications, standard practices and operating procedures.

  • Remains in contact with customers, property owners, general public, other contractors, and utility representatives and governmental agencies 20-30% of the time. Promotes and maintains good customer and public relations through courteous communication on behalf of Wright Tree Service.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and in close proximity to energized power lines.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster. Assists with contacting and coordinating the crew’s response to such work and responsible for determining proper steps necessary to eliminate hazards and trim/remove trees while onsite during emergency response.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

  • Oversees crew employees.

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Possess excellent leadership skills and be able to handle stressful situations along with being able to multi-task.

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with the general public, customers and employees at all levels.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere, educate, and enforce company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office products.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to write, read, and comprehend written and verbal job instructions/information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 4-5 years’ experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements). and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

Language Requirements (read, write, speak):

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Spanish - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Other Language _________________ - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Travel Requirements:

☐No-Seldom

☐Yes-Occasional (up to 5%)

☐Yes-Moderate (5% to 25%)

☒Yes-Substantial (25% to 50%)

☐Yes-Extensive (greater than 50%)

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.

  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

Environmental Factors:

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to indoor and outdoor working conditions.

  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.

  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.

  • Routine exposure to noise, vibration, working hazards such as proximity to moving parts, mechanical equipment, moving vehicles, gasoline powered equipment, electrical current, heights, exposure to heat, exposure to chemicals, work in close quarters, narrow aisles or passageways, communicable diseases, bloodborne pathogens, cleaning chemicals, dust, odors, and a variety of pests.

Any such agreement must be in writing signed by the Chief Executive Officer or the Chief Executive Officer’s designee.
