title: Senior Geotechnical Engineer
description:
Description

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

SLC works on behalf of clients to support utility-scale solar, wind, battery energy storage, thermal power, and other power and infrastructure projects. We evaluate and optimize technical, commercial, environmental, social responsibility, and financial aspects of the projects for a variety of clients.

This position will require you to perform high quality design and consulting services as part of multidisciplined project teams for challenging domestic and international, power and industrial projects. These engineering services include but are not limited to earth retention systems, deep and shallow foundation design, dam stability analyses and inspections, in-situ instrumentation and monitoring programs, subsurface exploration, seismic stability and liquefaction analyses, ground improvement, groundwater supply wells, and field oversight of exploration and construction activities.

Typical responsibilities may include:

  • Support preparation and review of geotechnical reports and calculations for conformity with project specifications.
  • Prepare and review specifications for subsurface investigations, deep foundations, ground improvement, earth retaining systems, monitoring wells, water production wells, and general earthwork.
  • Advise power project developers to support new utility-scale solar, wind, battery energy storage, thermal, and other projects;
  • Evaluate new power and infrastructure projects independently to support financing
  • Develop technical reports for applicable audiences – including owners, developers, governmental agencies and committees, and financiers
  • Conduct occasional on-site quality surveillance of subsurface exploration programs, pile installation and pile testing.
  • Occasional domestic and/or international travel

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • This position requires a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering with a geotechnical focus. A Master’s degree with a strong background and coursework in geotechnical engineering discipline is a plus.
  • 8+ years of detailed geotechnical design, including soil remediation, deep foundations, driven, predrilled, and helical pile design
  • Experience in working in design of power, transmission, or other heavy industry projects, including on-site quality surveillance of subsurface exploration programs, pile installation and pile testing.
  • Experience in writing and providing support documentation for Geotechnical Engineering specifications or calculations.
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • Ability to prioritize multiple parallel, fast-paced tasks within schedule and assigned budget
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including technical evaluation report writing

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Professional Engineering (PE) license
  • Experience specific to wind turbine generation and/or solar PV design
  • Experience with unique subsurface conditions
  • Technical evaluation report writing
  • Ability and willingness to travel, both domestic and international.
  • Multi-discipline teamwork (i.e. design projects, co-ops)
  • Data analysis and visualization
  • Project finance or business acumen
  • Conceptual project design
  • Construction project management and/or scheduling software knowledge
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills
  • Solid interpersonal skills and ability to work with and guide others
  • Project planning, leadership, and organizational skills

AI & Automation at Sargent & Lundy

In this role, we expect people to be willing or able to lead others who use modern tools:

  • You are expected to lead others in taking engineering problems from issue to solution by setting expectations for using data and modern tools such as automation and AI to improve workflows, reduce rework, and deliver cost-effective designs.
  • Leaders in these roles often direct automation and process-improvement work, for example, how teams automate calculations, summarize technical documents, or generate design documentation and guiding when and how AI or agentic AI tools are used while ensuring results are checked.
  • Overseeing engineers who program or script (e.g., Python, MATLAB, advanced Excel) to automate engineering tasks, with review of automated outputs, is valued but not required.
  • We also value additional learning, such as a minor, certificate, or other experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or related fields that enables effective oversight of automation and agentic AI-enabled engineering workflows.

Award-Winning Benefits

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

title: Construction Estimator (Firestopping, Fireproofing & Insulation)
description:
Job Title: Construction Estimator (Firestopping, Fireproofing & Insulation)

Job Type: Full-Time, remote

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, US Pacific Standard Time (California)

Salary: USD $1,500–$2,500/month

Location: Latin America

About the Company

Our client is a growing U.S.-based specialty construction contractor that provides insulation, firestopping, and fireproofing services for residential and commercial construction projects. They work closely with general contractors and builders to deliver high-quality installations that meet safety standards, building codes, and project deadlines.

The company operates with a lean, collaborative team and values professionals who are proactive, dependable, and able to take ownership of their work. This is an excellent opportunity to join a stable organization where your contributions will have a direct impact on winning new projects and supporting continued growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Construction Estimator with experience estimating U.S. construction projects, particularly within insulation, firestopping, or fireproofing scopes. You will be responsible for preparing accurate quantity takeoffs, reviewing construction documents, and producing competitive cost estimates for a variety of residential and commercial projects.

The ideal candidate has strong technical estimating skills, is comfortable working independently, and thrives in a fast-paced environment while supporting a U.S.-based construction team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs and cost estimates for insulation, firestopping, and fireproofing projects.

  • Review construction drawings, specifications, addenda, and bid documents to ensure complete project scope.

  • Estimate residential, commercial, tenant improvement (TI), remodel, and ground-up construction projects.

  • Develop labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor cost estimates.

  • Utilize estimating and digital takeoff software such as BAS-SPEED, On-Screen Takeoff (OST), Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or similar platforms.

  • Identify scope gaps, risks, and opportunities for value engineering.

  • Coordinate with internal team members to ensure estimated accuracy and timely bid submissions.

  • Maintain organized estimating documentation and project files.

  • Manage multiple bids while consistently meeting deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.

  • 3–6+ years of experience estimating U.S.-based construction projects.

  • Proven estimating experience in insulation projects is highly preferred.

  • Experience with firestopping and/or fireproofing scopes is strongly preferred.

  • Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents.

  • Excellent analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

Required Software Experience

Candidates should have experience with one or more of the following:

  • On-Screen Takeoff (OST)

  • BAS-SPEED (or the ability to quickly learn)

  • Bluebeam Revu

  • PlanSwift

  • Other digital estimating or takeoff software

  • Microsoft Excel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience estimating California or West Coast U.S. construction projects.

  • Experience working for U.S. subcontractors or specialty trade contractors.

  • Knowledge of fire-rated assemblies, insulation systems, and applicable building codes.

  • Experience estimating both residential and commercial construction projects.

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
The primary role of a Maintenance Technician involves maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting building systems, machinery, and equipment to ensure safe, efficient operation, performing routine inspections, preventive tasks, and emergency fixes for electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and mechanical issues, and documenting all work to prevent downtime and uphold operational standards. In this position, you will need to use hand/power tools, diagnose faults, replace parts, and may specialize in areas like production machinery or facilities upkeep including the tunnels, vacuum lots and other requirements as needed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Repairs & Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and fixing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing problems; repairing or replacing defective parts.

  • Preventive Maintenance: Conducting routine checks, servicing equipment, and performing scheduled upkeep to prevent breakdowns.

  • System Management: Monitoring and maintaining HVAC, electrical, and other building systems.

  • Inspections: Regularly inspecting equipment and facilities to ensure safety and code compliance.

  • Documentation: Keeping detailed records of maintenance activities and repairs.

  • Emergency Response: Promptly responding to urgent maintenance requests.

  • Inventory: Managing spare parts and tools.

Essential Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with hand/power tools, diagnostics, and repair of various systems (mechanical, electrical, plumbing).

  • Problem-Solving: Strong ability to identify issues and find effective solutions.

  • Attention to Detail: Crucial for thorough inspections and accurate repairs.

  • Physical Ability: Capable of physical tasks required for maintenance work.

Work Environment

Base Pay Range

title: Chaplain Part - Time Kingsburg, CA - Bilingual Spanish Required
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Part - Time

Kingsburg, CA

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

• Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.

• Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.

• May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.

• May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.

• May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.

• Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.

• May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.

• May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.

• Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.

• Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).

• Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.

• With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

title: Crew Leader - Travel Pod
description:
Hourly Wage: $35.42

Division 15

Job Title: Crew Leader

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026

Job Summary:

The Crew Leader provides support and coaching to the crew to achieve production goals. This role identifies safety hazards and ensures compliance along with task allocation and prioritization of work on the job site as directed by their General Foreperson.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Adheres to and coaches employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods, and OSHA regulations. Assists with conducting necessary safety training, pre-job briefings, designating crew member assignments and coaching in accordance with company policies, procedures, and customer requirements.

  • Uses applicable herbicide equipment to treat stumps and brush. Maintain appropriate application records.

  • Obtains permission from property owners to trim or remove trees and apply herbicides. Works with customer or property owner to gain access to the job site, advises of potential interruption, and explains the work needing to be completed.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and in close proximity to energized power lines.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Conducts pre-inspection of work area to identify potential hazards.

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Promotes and maintains good customer and public relations through effective completion of assigned work and the appropriate behavior of employees on the crew.

  • Maintains records, and reports related to the production of the crew, such as timesheets, work orders, units of work, manhours, distribution of crew assignments and controlling costs, to meet organizational goals.

  • Obtains and interprets maps from General Foreperson or utility showing work orders to be completed for tree trimming, removals and chemical application. Responsible for understanding drawings and symbols representing types of power lines, voltages, and line equipment per industry standard and assisting General Foreperson with assigning daily work orders.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Staging and clean-up of tools and equipment at the job site. Maintains a neat and orderly work area.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster. Assists with contacting and coordinating the crew’s response to such work and responsible for determining proper steps necessary to eliminate hazards and trim/remove trees while onsite during emergency response.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Possess excellent leadership skills and be able to handle stressful situations along with being able to multi-task.

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and educate on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

Cargo: Crew Leader

Tipo de salario: No exento

Resumen del puesto:

El Crew Leader brinda apoyo y orientación al equipo de trabajo para alcanzar los objetivos de producción. La persona en este puesto identifica los posibles factores de riesgo a la seguridad y garantiza el cumplimiento de las normas, además de asignar tareas y priorizar el trabajo en el lugar de trabajo según las indicaciones de su General Foreperson.

Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Cumple con y orienta a los empleados sobre las políticas de la empresa, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de OSHA. Ayuda a impartir la capacitación en seguridad necesaria, realiza reuniones informativas previas al trabajo (job briefings), asigna tareas a los miembros del equipo de trabajo y brinda orientación conforme a las políticas, procedimientos y requisitos del cliente.

  • Utiliza equipos de aplicación de herbicidas según corresponda para tratar trocos y maleza (brush). Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.

  • Obtiene permisos de los propietarios para podar o eliminar árboles y aplicar herbicidas. Trabaja con el cliente o propietario para obtener acceso al lugar de trabajo, informa sobre posibles interrupciones y explica el trabajo que debe realizarse.

  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y en proximidad a líneas eléctricas energizadas.

  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.

  • Realiza inspecciones previas del área de trabajo para identificar posibles riesgos.

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.

  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.

  • Promueve y mantiene buenas relaciones con clientes y público mediante la correcta realización del trabajo asignado y el comportamiento apropiado de los empleados del equipo de trabajo.

  • Mantiene registros e informes relacionados con la producción del equipo de trabajo, como hojas de horas, órdenes de trabajo, unidades de producción, horas-hombre, distribución de tareas y control de costos, con el fin de cumplir los objetivos organizacionales.

  • Recibe e interpreta los mapas del General Foreperson o de la empresa de servicios públicos que muestran las órdenes de trabajo que deben completarse para la poda y la eliminación de árboles o la aplicación química. Es responsable de comprender los planos y símbolos que representan los tipos de líneas eléctricas, tensiones y equipos de líneas eléctricas según los estándares del sector, y de asistir al General Foreperson en la asignación de las órdenes de trabajo diarias.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Se encarga de la preparación y limpieza de herramientas y equipos en el lugar de trabajo. Mantiene un área de trabajo limpia y ordenada.

  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento. Colabora en la comunicación y coordinación de la respuesta del equipo de trabajo ante dichas situaciones, y es responsable de determinar los pasos adecuados para eliminar peligros y podar o retirar árboles durante las labores de respuesta.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de propiedad de empleados de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

title: Bilingual Salesforce Data Quality Assistant - 3 Month Fixed-Term Contract (LTG) Colombia, Remote
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, bilingual Salesforce Data Quality Assistant to support a defined 3-month remote project focused on the review and remediation of customer and financial records. The successful candidate will be responsible for systematically reviewing large volumes of data, cross-referencing entries against supporting PDF documentation (including customer records and invoices), and ensuring that information held within our systems is accurate, complete, and consistent.

This is a focused, process-driven position that will suit a candidate who demonstrates a high level of accuracy, discipline, and consistency in repetitive, detail-intensive work. While prior analytical or technical experience is not required, candidates must be reliable, methodical, and able to maintain a high standard of output throughout the duration of the contract.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review large datasets (in the order of several thousand rows) within Excel or Google Sheets, examining records on a line-by-line basis.
  • Open, review, and interpret supporting PDF documentation, including customer records and invoices, and reconcile their contents against corresponding system entries.
  • Identify and correct discrepancies, missing information, duplicate records, and other data quality issues, in line with documented procedures.
  • Escalate ambiguous, unusual, or out-of-scope cases to the project lead for review.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of work completed, changes made, and outstanding items, to support project tracking and reporting.
  • Deliver consistent quality and productivity throughout the duration of the engagement.

Essential Requirements

  • Demonstrable attention to detail and a methodical approach to repetitive tasks.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas, and standard data manipulation.
  • Ability to follow established processes accurately and consistently over an extended period.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to maintain regular, proactive contact with the project lead in a remote working environment.
  • Awareness of, and commitment to, the confidential handling of customer and financial information.
  • Capacity to work independently and manage personal productivity without direct day-to-day supervision.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous experience in a data entry, data clean-up, audit support, bookkeeping, or administrative role.
  • Familiarity with a customer relationship management (CRM) system, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Exposure to invoicing, accounts payable / receivable, or other standard financial documentation.

title: Tree Trimmer
description:

Job Title: Tree Trimmer

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Job Summary:

The Tree Trimmer role is a qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer responsible for pruning and removing trees, limbs and shrubs away from power lines to reduce vegetation interference. This role utilizes various types of equipment, tools, and techniques to perform basic tree maintenance while addressing growth patterns and ensuring tree health, and appearance.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Works aloft to cut branches or trunk sections and drop or lower them to the ground with rigging lines.

  • Uses appropriate tools on the ground to fell trees or spars and split them into manageable pieces.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and may work in close proximity to energized power lines while under the direct supervision of a qualified line clearance tree trimmer. Once the prerequisites for qualification have been met, may provide direct supervision of the activities of non-qualified employees working in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Applies herbicide and growth regulators to brush and stumps. Maintains appropriate application records.

  • Adheres to and helps educate less experienced employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods and OSHA regulations.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occurs on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Feeds brush and debris into woodchipper.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and coach employees on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to comprehend and/or read and write both written and verbal job instructions and safety information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

  • Has a minimum of 3 months of experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred, but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

Cargo: Tree Trimmer

Tipo de salario: No exento

Resumen del puesto:

El Tree Trimmer es un Qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer (podador calificado para el despeje de líneas) responsable de podar y retirar árboles, ramas y arbustos cerca de las líneas eléctricas para reducir la interferencia de la vegetación. La persona en esta función utiliza diversos equipos, herramientas y técnicas para realizar mantenimiento básico de los árboles, teniendo en cuenta los patrones de crecimiento y la salud y apariencia de los árboles.

Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño manejable que no pueden ser triturados.

  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de escalada, como camión con elevador de poda, cinturón de seguridad, cuerda de escalada y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de uso en el suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.

  • Trabaja en altura para cortar ramas o secciones de tronco y bajarlas al suelo con cuerdas de izado.

  • Utiliza herramientas apropiadas en el suelo para talar árboles o troncos y dividirlos en piezas fáciles de manipular.

  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y puede desempeñarse en proximidad a líneas energizadas bajo la supervisión directa de un Qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer (podador calificado para el despeje de líneas). Una vez cumplidos los requisitos para la calificación, puede supervisar directamente las actividades de empleados no calificados que trabajan cerca de conductores energizados.

  • Aplica herbicidas y reguladores de crecimiento a la maleza (brush) y los troncos. Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.

  • Cumple y ayuda a capacitar a empleados con menos experiencia sobre las políticas de la empresa, los procedimientos, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de la Administración de Salud Ocupacional (OSHA).

  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.

  • Alimenta la trituradora de madera con maleza y residuos.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson. sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de pertenencia de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Debe tener conocimientos básicos sobre los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.

  • Conocimiento y comprensión de las normas nacionales estadounidenses para operaciones de cuidado de árboles (ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la poda adecuada (ANSI A300).

  • Capacidad para cumplir y capacitar a los empleados sobre los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.

  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.

  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de la OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.

  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.

  • Capacidad para comprender o leer y escribir tanto las instrucciones laborales como la información de seguridad, en forma escrita y verbal.

  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.

  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.

  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.

  • Conocimiento y formación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).

  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.

  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Contar con un mínimo de 3 meses de experiencia trabajando en cuadrillas de poda o despeje de árboles, o haber completado con éxito las evaluaciones de habilidades correspondientes.

  • Se prefiere título de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.

  • Debe contar con credenciales vigentes de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR), o poder obtenerlas en un plazo de 90 días tras la contratación.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Departamento de Transporte (Department of Transportation, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de la FMCSA.

  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.

  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.

  • Mantenerse informado sobre nuevos equipos, especificaciones, normas, prácticas y procedimientos operativos.

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

  • Flexionarse, estirarse, permanecer de pie, caminar, trepar, levantar, cargar, sujetar, hablar, oír y realizar movimientos repetitivos de manera efectiva. Ocasionalmente alcanzar hacia arriba o hacia abajo.

  • Ejercer hasta 100 libras (45 kg) de fuerza ocasionalmente o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza con frecuencia, o hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza de manera constante para mover objetos.

  • Poseer la capacidad para levantar, mover y maniobrar hasta 50 libras (23 kg) ocasionalmente y hasta 30 libras (14 kg) con frecuencia.

  • Debe tener agudeza visual suficiente para determinar la precisión, pulcritud y exhaustividad del trabajo asignado o para hacer observaciones generales del entorno; agudeza visual cercana, como para leer una pantalla de computadora, materiales impresos, inspeccionar defectos pequeños o utilizar instrumentos de medición.

Job Summary:

The Crew Leader provides support and coaching to the crew to achieve production goals. This role identifies safety hazards and ensures compliance along with task allocation and prioritization of work on the job site as directed by their General Foreperson.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Adheres to and coaches employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods, and OSHA regulations. Assists with conducting necessary safety training, pre-job briefings, designating crew member assignments and coaching in accordance with company policies, procedures, and customer requirements.

  • Uses applicable herbicide equipment to treat stumps and brush. Maintain appropriate application records.

  • Obtains permission from property owners to trim or remove trees and apply herbicides. Works with customer or property owner to gain access to the job site, advises of potential interruption, and explains the work needing to be completed.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and in close proximity to energized power lines.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Conducts pre-inspection of work area to identify potential hazards.

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Promotes and maintains good customer and public relations through effective completion of assigned work and the appropriate behavior of employees on the crew.

  • Maintains records, and reports related to the production of the crew, such as timesheets, work orders, units of work, manhours, distribution of crew assignments and controlling costs, to meet organizational goals.

  • Obtains and interprets maps from General Foreperson or utility showing work orders to be completed for tree trimming, removals and chemical application. Responsible for understanding drawings and symbols representing types of power lines, voltages, and line equipment per industry standard and assisting General Foreperson with assigning daily work orders.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Staging and clean-up of tools and equipment at the job site. Maintains a neat and orderly work area.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster. Assists with contacting and coordinating the crew’s response to such work and responsible for determining proper steps necessary to eliminate hazards and trim/remove trees while onsite during emergency response.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Possess excellent leadership skills and be able to handle stressful situations along with being able to multi-task.

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and educate on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to write, read, and comprehend written and verbal job instructions/information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 3 years’ experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Obtiene permisos de los propietarios para podar o eliminar árboles y aplicar herbicidas. Trabaja con el cliente o propietario para obtener acceso al lugar de trabajo, informa sobre posibles interrupciones y explica el trabajo que debe realizarse.

  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y en proximidad a líneas eléctricas energizadas.

  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.

  • Realiza inspecciones previas del área de trabajo para identificar posibles riesgos.

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.

  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.

  • Promueve y mantiene buenas relaciones con clientes y público mediante la correcta realización del trabajo asignado y el comportamiento apropiado de los empleados del equipo de trabajo.

  • Mantiene registros e informes relacionados con la producción del equipo de trabajo, como hojas de horas, órdenes de trabajo, unidades de producción, horas-hombre, distribución de tareas y control de costos, con el fin de cumplir los objetivos organizacionales.

  • Recibe e interpreta los mapas del General Foreperson o de la empresa de servicios públicos que muestran las órdenes de trabajo que deben completarse para la poda y la eliminación de árboles o la aplicación química. Es responsable de comprender los planos y símbolos que representan los tipos de líneas eléctricas, tensiones y equipos de líneas eléctricas según los estándares del sector, y de asistir al General Foreperson en la asignación de las órdenes de trabajo diarias.

  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.

  • Se encarga de la preparación y limpieza de herramientas y equipos en el lugar de trabajo. Mantiene un área de trabajo limpia y ordenada.

  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.

  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento. Colabora en la comunicación y coordinación de la respuesta del equipo de trabajo ante dichas situaciones, y es responsable de determinar los pasos adecuados para eliminar peligros y podar o retirar árboles durante las labores de respuesta.

  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de propiedad de empleados de Wright.

  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.

  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo y capacidad para manejar situaciones de estrés, así como para realizar múltiples tareas simultáneamente.

  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.

  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con el público, los clientes y los empleados.

  • Conocimiento y comprensión de American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para Operaciones de Cuidado de Árboles - ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de American National Standards for Proper Pruning (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la Poda Adecuada - ANSI A300).

  • Capacidad para cumplir y enseñar los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.

  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.

  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.

  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.

  • Capacidad para redactar, leer y comprender instrucciones o información laboral, tanto escritas como verbales.

  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.

  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.

  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.

  • Conocimiento y capacitación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).

  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.

  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Contar con un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia trabajando en equipos de poda o despeje de árboles, o haber completado con éxito las evaluaciones de habilidades correspondientes.

  • Se prefiere diploma de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.

  • Debe contar con credenciales vigentes de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR), o poder obtenerlas en un plazo de 90 días tras la contratación.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Departamento de Transporte (Department of Transportation, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de la FMCSA.

  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.

  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.

  • Mantenerse informado sobre nuevos equipos, especificaciones, normas, prácticas y procedimientos operativos.

Características físicas:

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

  • Flexionarse, estirarse, permanecer de pie, caminar, trepar, levantar, cargar, sujetar, hablar, oír y realizar movimientos repetitivos de manera efectiva. Ocasionalmente alcanzar hacia arriba o hacia abajo.

  • Poseer la capacidad para levantar, mover y maniobrar hasta 50 libras (23 kg) ocasionalmente y hasta 30 libras (14 kg) con frecuencia.

Factores ambientales:

Las personas en este puesto pueden estar expuestas a los siguientes factores:

title: Global Study Associate Director - CVRM
description:
Join us as a Global Study Associate Director (GSAD) in our BioPharmaceuticals Clinical Operations team at AstraZeneca’s dynamic R&D site in Gothenburg (Sweden). This role is pivotal in the delivery of clinical studies, providing direction and guidance to a cross-functional study team within the Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM) therapy area. As the main liaison between the study team and the Clinical Program Team (CPT), you will be accountable for the delivery of a study according to agreed timelines, budget, and quality standards.

Accountabilities

As a GSAD, you will lead and provide guidance to a cross-functional study team, ensuring the clinical study progresses as planned. You will be responsible for developing essential study level documents, overseeing external service providers, and ensuring all systems used at a study-level are current and accurate. You will also oversee study level performance against agreed upon plans, milestones, and key performance indicators. Additionally, you will be responsible for study budget re-forecasting and management throughout the study lifecycle.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • University degree (or equivalent), preferably in medical or biological sciences or discipline associated with clinical research

  • Relevant clinical experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including project management experience

  • Extensive study management experience

  • Extensive knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research regulatory requirements

  • Demonstrated solid project management skills

  • Strong abilities in team leadership with experience from cross-functional leadership of a clinical study or part of a clinical study

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Strong strategic and critical thinking abilities

  • Ability to manage competing priorities

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Advanced degree, master's level education (or higher)

  • Project management certification

  • Proven project management experience on a global level

  • Experience in all phases of a clinical study lifecycle

At AstraZeneca, we are driven by our passion for science and our commitment to making a difference. We fuse data and technology with the latest scientific innovations to achieve breakthroughs that have never been done before. Our inclusive environment allows us to work seamlessly as one, leveraging our diverse global knowledge to create the greatest impact on disease. We are constantly advancing our scientific knowledge to shape the future of healthcare and improve patient access to life-changing medicines.

If you are ready to make a significant impact on patients' lives and push the boundaries of science, apply now!

We welcome your application by Aug 16th, 2026.

24-juli-2026

16-aug.-2026

Our mission is to build an inclusive and equitable environment. We want people to feel they belong at AstraZeneca and Alexion, starting with our recruitment process. title: Technical Engineer III
description:
Job Summary

Aptive is seeking a Technical Engineer to provide guidance and advanced technical engineering expertise supporting the ICE Health Service Corps (IHSC) Health Information Technology Unit (HITU) in the management and monitoring of modernized Health IT programs. This role provides technical oversight, analysis, and advisory support to ensure IT systems are designed, implemented, and maintained in alignment with operational needs, security requirements, and enterprise architecture standards.

The Technical Engineer evaluates system architectures, technical designs, and solution proposals; identifies and assesses technical risks such as scalability, interoperability, and performance; and advises leadership on technical tradeoffs and mitigation strategies. This is a designated Key Personnel position under the contract.

The ideal candidate brings advanced enterprise IT and architecture knowledge and can communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical decision-makers. This role is advisory in nature and provides technical analysis, validation, and recommendations rather than performing development, configuration, or operational control within vendor-managed environments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced technical engineering analysis and advisory support for IHSC enterprise IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Evaluate system architectures, technical designs, and solution proposals for alignment with operational, security, and performance requirements.
  • Support the review of, and provide recommendations for, enterprise system modernization, integration, and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Identify and assess technical risks, including scalability, interoperability, performance, and sustainability.
  • Review and validate technical documentation, system designs, and engineering deliverables.
  • Collaborate with project managers, developers, security teams, and OCIO stakeholders.
  • Support troubleshooting of complex technical issues affecting multiple systems.
  • Advise leadership on technical tradeoffs, risks, and mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure technical recommendations align with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced technical knowledge of enterprise IT systems, infrastructure, and architecture.
  • Experience evaluating technical designs, system architectures, and engineering solutions for alignment with operational and security requirements.
  • Ability to provide technical oversight and advisory support to leadership and technical teams.
  • Strong understanding of system modernization, integration, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience identifying and mitigating technical risks, including scalability, performance, and interoperability concerns.
  • Ability to review and validate technical documentation, system designs, and engineering deliverables.
  • Proven skill troubleshooting complex technical issues across systems and platforms.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS/ICE fitness determination (public trust) and execute a DHS Non-Disclosure Agreement.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DHS, ICE, IHSC, or other federal healthcare IT or EHR modernization (EHRM) programs.
  • Experience collaborating with OCIO and vendor stakeholders in a multi-contract enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and federal IT security requirements.
  • Understanding of healthcare IT systems, workflows, and interoperability standards.

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. Job Title:

Dialysis Technician

Job Summary:

To function under the supervision of an RN/LPN. Dialysis and to provide assistance with hemodialysis treatment and renal procedures to ensure equipment and instruments are properly functioning during renal procedures. To provide the dialysis team with basic assistance, ensuring patient comfort and providing quality patient care. To ensure dialysis equipment and instruments are sterilized in accordance with UMMC infection control and regulatory standards.

Education & Experience

Certifications, Licenses or Registration required: Certified Hemodialysis Technician (CHT) from MDOH (Miss. Department of Health) required.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Verbal and written communication skills. Interpersonal skills including effective interaction with dialysis team members. Team-oriented.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
All Hub links

Hub is a multimodal data lab for physical AI, based in San Francisco, backed by Y Combinator.

Accelerating Embodied AGI

Robot foundation models learn physical behavior from human demonstration, and real-world data has become a critical bottleneck in embodied intelligence.

Hub provides real-world training data to frontier AI labs and robotics companies, scaling multiple 7 to 8 figure contracts. Our network of 150,000+ users captures egocentric human data across all continents, processed and QA'd end to end.

Hub's mission is to advance embodied AGI through real-world data and research.

We're assembling a unique team of exceptional and relentless individuals, willing to dedicate themselves fully to the achievement of this mission.

The Role

As a founding engineer you own some of the most critical systems in the company.

  • Multiple platforms with 150K+ users collecting data: B2C, B2B, mobile app, internal.
  • Anti-fraud and automated QA systems. You own the quality of what we deliver every day.
  • Heavy backend, keeping architecture and ops efficient as we scale to 1M+ users.
  • Payout systems moving daily high volumes of money across 100+ countries.
  • Live production serving multiple top 5 AI companies, hard deadlines and specs.

The Profile

Graduates from top French engineering schools, 6 months to 5 years of experience. We look for outliers with outstanding achievements and unreasonable grit.

  • Exceptional individual achievement: hackathons won, elite rankings at competitions or concours, system you hacked, projects at real scale or revenue.
  • You live for programming. Thousands of contributions on GitHub this year, active open-source participation, frequent late nights building on weekends on your own.
  • You treat agentic engineering as a craft. You research the field daily and always run a SOTA customized harness.
  • You're willing to sacrifice to be part of an extraordinary journey, working at the center of the embodied AGI frontier alongside the biggest AI labs.

Culture

  • Small core team by design. Y Combinator + SF high-performance culture and pace.
  • French founders, team across SF, Europe, LATAM.
  • High accountability. Features owned end to end: design, build, ship, support.
  • Token-maxxing ethos. Uncapped frontier models, fleets of agents, shared skills and KB.
  • Multiple features shipped per day, output of an org 50 times the size.
  • Constant proactive communication. Slack, huddles, short standups. No black box.
  • We hold a higher bar for ourselves than anyone could hold for us.

Stack

  • Python, FastAPI, Postgres, React, Docker, GCP, S3 and Backblaze, versioned REST APIs.
  • Mobile: React Native and Expo, one codebase across iOS and Android, ARKit and ARCore under it for egocentric video capture. RGB+IMU sync, MCAP out.
  • Multimodal pipelines at petabyte scale: ingestion, VLM QA and labeling, fraud detection, stereo depth and hand reconstruction, delivery in MCAP and LeRobot.
  • We build our own custom platforms, not assembled SaaS: contributor app, commercial platform, mobile app, internal, payouts.

What We Offer

  • Founding engineer in one of the fastest-growing Y Combinator startup.
  • $60,000 to $90,000 yearly salary, stock options between 0.25% and 1%.
  • Remote, based in France. Paris office opening soon.
  • Direct work with the founders. Direct work with top AI labs.

To Apply

Send us a short application, in your own words. We want to hear the thing you've done that you achieved that you’re the most proud of, your professional handles (GitHub, links, etc), and the story behind your achievements.

If you want to spend the next years building the foundations of embodied AGI, working alongside the biggest labs, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About Symbiotic

Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.

By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.

As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.


Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink, Nexus Mutual, and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.

See how Symbiotic is powering the next generation of onchain finance: symbiotic.fi

Our People

We’re a tight-knit team of experienced builders working at the forefront of financial infrastructure. Our backgrounds span high-growth tech start-ups, leading crypto companies, major banks, insurers, and financial institutions. We work with ownership, a high bar for craft, and the urgency of an early-stage company - in an environment where people are trusted to take initiative and supported to do their best work.

We’re looking for talented professionals to join us at a defining moment, as Symbiotic helps shape the next generation of onchain finance.

Responsibilities

• Lead the product design function collaborating closely with Leadership, Engineering, Product and Marketing teams

• Design the full user journey for Symbiotic's product stack making onchain complexity legible and optimising for clean user flows.

• Surface risk, exposure, and returns so users understand what they're committing to and what happens when conditions change.

• Run user research. You'll interview users, watch how they actually behave, and turn what you find into concrete feature scopes engineering can build from.

• Partner closely with Engineering to define problems, weigh tradeoffs, and design within real protocol constraints rather than around them.

Requirements

• Deep on-chain fluency: wallets, approvals, signing, gas, transaction lifecycle, chain latency — and a working understanding of how each one constrains what's designable.

• You've shipped a DeFi product to real users, and you can point to it

• A portfolio showing end-to-end product work — systems-level thinking alongside obsessive detail.

• Track record of operating autonomously in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with limited oversight.

• Comfortable without scaffolding: no design team, no design system to inherit, no one queuing your work.

• You run your own research rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

• Excellent cross-functional communication — you can partner closely with Engineering and hold a position under scrutiny.

• Deep fluency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows.

Job Description:

The Pricing Analyst is responsible for maintaining and implementing product pricing strategies across multiple customer channels and lubricant product lines. The role manages pricing data in SAP and related systems, ensuring compliance with financial governance standards while supporting Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and customers. Key responsibilities include pricing analysis, market and competitor monitoring, price implementation, reporting, process improvement, and system optimization. The Pricing Analyst works multi-functionally to translate business objectives into pricing actions, resolve pricing issues, and provide insights that drive revenue, profitability, and pricing performance.

  • Implement and maintain product and customer pricing within pricing/ERP systems, including price changes, product setup, and discount/rebate structures, ensuring alignment with governance frameworks.
  • Support price change execution processes in SAP ECC/ERP systems, including identifying impacted customers and products, performing changes (using existing or creating templates) and validation checks to ensure accurate implementation.
  • Translate commercial strategies and business objectives into accurate, system-ready pricing instructions.
  • Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer behavior to identifyopportunities for pricing optimization.
  • Complete pricing changes to optimize volume, revenue, and profitability.
  • Develop pricing strategies to support new and existing products.
  • Develop and maintain pricing frameworks across customers, products, and channels within Castrol’s strategic and operational pricing environments, including list price, discounts, promotions, surcharges, and rebates.
  • Perform pricing analysis on volume, price, discount, rebate, and cost components to support financial performance insights and business decision-making.
  • Build and maintain financial and data models and reports (Excel required; Power BI preferred) to analyze price/discount/margin relationships, margin performance, and pricing scenarios (e.g., variance analysis across price waterfalls).
  • Develop dashboards and reporting (Power BI or equivalent) to provide awareness of pricing performance, targets, and key commercial insights for partners.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve pricing system issues, conflicts, and data inconsistencies; advance and recommend solutions as needed.
  • Partner multi-functionally with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations to understand commercial objectives of price changes and report and summarize change outcomes.
  • Understand and report information in a language consistent with a P&L, including gross revenue, discounts, rebates, allowances, net revenue, COGS, gross profit, and operating expenses.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities, simplifying processes, and enhancing pricing system capabilities. Ability to improve pricing-change speed-to-market is key.
  • Document pricing processes and support knowledge transfer to ensure continuity and operational resilience.
  • Support development and evaluation of customer offers by providing pricing analysis, profitability insights, and reporting outputs for various B2B and B2B2C routes to market.

  • 3+ years of SAP ECC/ERP system hands-on execution experience

title: Senior MSK Physiotherapist

You will see a wide range of musculoskeletal conditions and post operative cases, playing a key role in helping our patients achieve, maintain and recover to the level of health and wellbeing that they aspire to.

You will work within a multidisciplinary team including nurses, AHPS and consultants in order to optimise the health and recovery of our patients.

The hospital is brilliantly placed to support and mentor the successful candidate for this role, alongside our academy training programmes.

As a Senior Physiotherapist, you will:

  • Deliver high quality, effective clinical care.

  • Adhere to our values and beliefs at Nuffield Health, in which we encourage behaviour which is enterprising, passionate, independent and caring.

  • Deliver excellent clinical care that is evidence based, Safe, Effective, Caring, Well-led and responsive to our patient’s needs.

  • Ensure on-going monitoring of the standard of treatment provided.

  • Be compliant with all professional, clinical and integrated governance standards and participate in clinical audit and other quality assurance processes.

To succeed as a Senior Physiotherapist, you will:

  • Have a BSc in Physiotherapy or equivalent, you’ll be registered with the Health and Care Professions Council.

  • Demonstrate evidence of further professional training and continual professional development, reflecting your desire to develop as a practitioner.

  • Be a confident communicator with the ability to engage effectively with the general public and other healthcare professionals.

  • Be able to demonstrate excellent rehabilitation skills.

  • Be a competent and confident IT user with strong organisation skills.

  • Have the ability to prioritise and deal with your varied workload in an effective and timely manner.

It’s equally important that you share our values. We believe in putting people first and providing personalised, holistic healthcare. That makes you part of a much wider team, working to create a healthier future for each individual client.

Supporting your growth.

We’re committed to the professional development of all our clinical colleagues. Inside our Learning and Development Academy, you’ll discover a range of internal CPD courses and online content to support your clinical and professional development. As a Nuffield Health Physiotherapist, you’ll also enjoy opportunities to apply for funding support towards your relevant CPD activity and postgraduate study. Plus, you can access further professional development opportunities via the large number of apprenticeship programmes we offer.

Helping you feel good.

We want you to love coming to work, feeling healthy, happy and valued. That’s why we’ve developed a benefits package with you in mind. Here, you can choose from a range of fitness, lifestyle, health and fitness wellbeing rewards, such as free gym membership, health assessments, retail discounts and pension options. At Nuffield Health, we take care of what’s important to you.

Join Nuffield Health and create the future you want, today.
